title: Technical Product Owner II
descriptionHtml:
Job Description

As a Technical Product Owner II here at Honeywell, you will lead and mentor a team of Technical Product Owners, providing strategic guidance and overseeing the entire product development lifecycle. Collaboration with cross-functional teams, including product managers and engineers, will be a key aspect of your role, ensuring a cohesive approach to product development. Your strategic influence will extend to driving innovation within the product management function, identifying opportunities for technological advancements, and actively participating in strategic decision-making to shape the overall direction of the Technical Product Owner team.

In this role, you will impact Honeywell's position at the forefront of technological advancements by driving efficient and timely product development, contributing to continuous improvement and innovation, and ensuring the delivery of high-quality products that meet customer needs.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define and prioritize technical requirements
  • Drive the development of technical specifications and ensure alignment with overall product strategy
  • Provide technical guidance to the development team throughout the product lifecycle
  • Work closely with the Technical Product Owner Manager to ensure timely and successful product delivery
  • Actively participate in product planning and roadmap discussions

Qualifications

YOU MUST HAVE

  • 2+ years of experience in a Technical Product Owner management role or similar technical leadership position
  • Mastery understanding of software development methodologies and processes
  • Experience working in agile development environments and familiarity with agile principles
  • Proven track record of successfully managing technical teams

WE VALUE

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or another related field.
  • Certifications in product management or agile methodologies (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner).
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Attention to detail and excellent problem-solving capability

About Us

Honeywell helps organizations solve the world's most complex challenges in automation, the future of aviation and energy transition. As a trusted partner, we provide actionable solutions and innovation through our Aerospace Technologies, Building Automation, Energy and Sustainability Solutions, and Industrial Automation business segments – powered by our Honeywell Forge software – that help make the world smarter, safer and more sustainable.

title: Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
About Persistent

We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654.4M FY26 revenue with 17.4% Y-o-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3.2% Q-o-Q and 16.2% Y-o-Y growth. Our 27,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2026.

About Position

We are hiring a Product Owner with strong Lending (LOS) domain expertise to drive product vision, prioritize features, and lead Agile delivery. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into impactful solutions, ensuring seamless product execution and enhanced customer experience in a fast-paced fintech environment. Please mention a brief description of the position.

  • Role: Product Owner
  • Location: Any PSL Location
  • Experience: 6 to 10 Years
  • Job Type: Full Time Employment

What You'll Do

  • Assess business value, develop business cases, and prioritize epics, stories, and themes aligned with product vision and strategic goals.
  • Define and manage product deliveries, release plans, and feature scope in collaboration with platform leadership.
  • Draft product objectives and strategies, leveraging data-driven insights for decision-making.
  • Define and track KPIs; utilize analytics, A/B testing, and user feedback to refine product features.
  • Convert functional specifications into actionable user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
  • Own, maintain, and refine the product backlog; lead backlog grooming and sprint planning sessions.
  • Manage release planning and track progress through development and QA phases in collaboration with the Scrum Master.
  • Lead software gate reviews, including formal and informal handoffs.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders on product visioning and concept development.
  • Translate complex sprint outcomes and technical updates into business-friendly summaries.
  • Act as the voice of the customer across engineering, UX, QA, and business teams.
  • Proactively identify and escalate risks and impediments to program leadership.
  • Ensure understanding of end-to-end customer experience, integrations, and technical dependencies.
  • Drive continuous improvement in product development practices.
  • Thrive in a collaborative, team-oriented culture with shared accountability.

Expertise You'll Bring

  • Experience working as a Product Owner or in a similar role within software product development.
  • Strong domain knowledge in Lending (LOS mandatory) and familiarity with LMS systems.
  • Solid understanding of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban); SAFe experience is a plus.
  • Proven ability to write clear user stories and translate business requirements into technical specifications.
  • Hands-on experience collaborating with engineering, QA, UX, and cross-functional teams.
  • Product Owner certification preferred; Scrum Master certification is an added advantage.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
  • Advanced English communication skills (B2+ or higher).
  • Prior experience in FinTech is a plus.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
  • Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
  • Annual health check-ups
  • Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  • We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
  • Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
  • If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment

Let’s unleash your full potential at Persistent - persistent.com/careers

“Persistent is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind.”

title: Director I
descriptionHtml:
Overview

As a Director of Product Management for Payments at RealPage, you are a senior strategic leader responsible for shaping and executing the vision, strategy, and customer value delivery of Payments product within the portfolio. You will lead and mentor a high-performing team of Product Managers, ensuring alignment with organizational goals while driving innovation, market impact, and customer success. Reporting directly to the Vice President of Payments Product, you will play a pivotal role in defining product direction, guiding lifecycle strategies, and representing RealPage as a thought leader in the industry.

Responsibilities

  • Leadership & Team Development
    • Manage, mentor, set career paths, and grow a large team of Product Managers.
    • Foster a culture of accountability, Cross-functional collaboration, and innovation.
  • Strategic Product Ownership
    • Lead and own strategic products or technical product areas within the Payments portfolio.
    • Focus on people leadership and delivery of strategic outcomes.
    • Collaborate and set strategic product direction including project creation and alignment for quarterly & annual road mapping cycles
  • Financial & Business Management
    • Establish Key success metrics for overall financial impact of product decisions.
    • Responsible for product-level budget goals as assigned
    • Ensure product investments align with business objectives and ROI targets.
  • Vision & Roadmap
    • Align product initiatives with corporate strategy and market opportunities.
  • Lifecycle Management
    • Develop and execute product lifecycle strategies, including go-to-market, migration, transformation, escalation management and sunset planning.
  • Market Readiness & Enablement
    • Drive product introduction and launch readiness across multiple initiatives.
    • Partner with design and enablement teams to ensure successful adoption and customer engagement.
    • Measure performance against metrics post launch, to validate success
  • Customer & Market Engagement
    • Lead discovery initiatives, user groups, and customer feedback forums.
    • Translate insights into actionable product strategies that deliver measurable value.
  • Industry Leadership
    • Represent RealPage at industry conferences and events.
    • Provide thought leadership and market perspective for targeted product lines.
Qualifications

 Qualifications

  • 12- 15 years of industry-specific domain experience and/or relevant business/product management expertise.
  • 8-10 years of management experience leading product teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Proven ability to define and execute product vision and strategy at scale.
  • Strong financial acumen with experience managing budgets and assessing product ROI.
  • Expertise in product lifecycle management, including migration and sunset strategies.
  • Exceptional leadership, mentoring, and team development skills.
  • Strong communication and executive presence, with experience in public speaking and industry thought leadership.
  • Ability to engage with customers, synthesize insights, and translate them into impactful product outcomes.

title: Lead Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
Role Summary:-

The Lead Product Owner drives complex product initiatives, mentors Product Owners and Analysts, and establishes delivery standards across functional domains.

The role is expected to lead adoption of AI-enabled delivery operating models and drive consistency, scalability, and quality across teams.

The Lead Product Owner is a member of the Product Management team of IDIT R&D, responsible for managing a team of Product Owners. The candidate should be able to run workshops with domain managers, Product Managers, and customers to elicit requirements, present solution designs, and take requirements through to implementation.

Pre-requisites

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering (CS/IT preferred) or equivalent qualification.
  • MBA preferred.

Experience

  • 8–12 years of relevant experience.
  • Should have some technical experience before transitioning to a BA/Product role.
  • Insurance or BFSI experience is a must.
  • Prior knowledge of Core Insurance is a must.
  • Experience of having worked in at least two implementation projects.
  • Led end-to-end requirements across multiple domains and modules.

Key Responsibilities

 Functional Leadership Responsibilities

  • Drive large and complex product initiatives across insurance functions.
  • Lead solution alignment across Product, Engineering, Architecture, QA, and Delivery teams.
  • Define product execution standards and governance practices.
  • Drive backlog prioritization aligned to strategic objectives.
  • Mentor Product Owners and Analysts; conduct training sessions for team members.
  • Support customer escalations and strategic initiatives.
  • Ensure consistency across functional deliverables and delivery practices.
  • Conduct User Forums and stakeholder workshops.
  • Work as a senior representative to project teams as needed.
  • Analysis and solution design using AI-assisted tools and frameworks.

AI-Enabled Leadership Responsibilities

  • Define AI-enabled delivery standards and best practices.
  • Establish reusable AI-assisted delivery patterns and knowledge frameworks.
  • Drive AI-assisted requirement quality and traceability standards.
  • Guide teams on responsible AI adoption.
  • Define review and validation mechanisms for AI-generated artifacts.
  • Identify opportunities for delivery acceleration using AI-assisted workflows.
  • Drive adoption of AI-enabled operating models across teams.

Mandatory Skills

  • Deep insurance domain expertise; strong understanding of insurance processes and core insurance systems.
  • Strong product ownership and solution leadership experience.
  • Experience in Product Ownership, Business Analysis, or Solution Design.
  • Ability to manage complex cross-functional requirements.
  • Strong stakeholder management and workshop facilitation skills.
  • Strong systems thinking and enterprise understanding.
  • Ability to lead cross-functional teams and initiatives.
  • Experience with Agile delivery methodologies.
  • Strong analytical and prioritization capabilities.
  • Working knowledge of APIs, integrations, and enterprise systems.
  • Excellent analytical skills and good design skills.
  • Advanced SQL and data modelling skills (mandatory).
  • Understanding of SDLC and Agile concepts (mandatory).
  • Very good verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to document business requirements as user stories; break large epics into smaller features and stories and document them in SDS.
  • Ability to conduct demos and walkthroughs with POs and business users.
  • Techno-functional and business solutioning capability.
  • Ability to effectively leverage AI-enabled delivery tools.
  • Strong understanding of AI-enabled delivery practices.
  • Experience with AI-enabled delivery platforms and workflows.
  • Exposure to prompt engineering and AI-assisted analysis.
  • Experience in modernization or transformation programs.
  • Exposure to AI governance and AI operating models.
  • Experience building reusable delivery frameworks.
  • Experience in using AI agents to elicit requirements and generate documentation.

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Exposure to Agentic AI concepts and orchestration-based workflows.
  • Exposure to digital transformation initiatives.

Key Characteristics

  • Strategic thinking.
  • Strong leadership and mentoring capability.
  • High ownership and accountability.
  • Ability to drive organizational change.
  • Ability to balance speed with quality and governance.
  • Systems thinking and cross-domain understanding.

title: Director - Markets - National - CBS - MKT - Global Markets/Client Service - New Delhi
descriptionHtml:
Requisition Id: 1656836

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that it’s your career and ‘It’s yours to build’ which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.

The opportunity : Director-National-Markets-CBS - MKT - Global Markets/Client Service - New Delhi

National :

National comprises of sector agnostic teams working across industries for a well rounded experience.

CBS - MKT - Global Markets/Client Service :

Our Markets team focuses on providing account teams with the support they need to help drive revenue growth. Our "account-centric" approach to serving clients starts with understanding their business and providing tools and enablers to provide consistency on how we identify and align our services and solutions to our clients' most pressing issues. We deliver services through one or more of our four global service lines: Assurance, Consulting, Strategy and Transactions and Tax. Our Markets team comprises of Business Development and Brand Media & Communication (BMC).

By adopting EY methodologies, executing on guidance, and leveraging tools and strategic programs, we bring the necessary rigor to our engagements. And by accessing our latest EY insights, solutions and client conversation tools, we have more meaningful conversations with our clients to help shape their thinking and generate additional value creation.

Your Key Responsibilities

Technical Excellence

  • The Director of Product will be responsible for driving the product vision, strategy, and execution across a portfolio of enterprise and SaaS platforms. This leader will work closely with business stakeholders, engineering, design, and data teams to build scalable, AI-enabled solutions that address real client needs while strengthening EY’s technology foundation. Key Responsibilities: Define and execute the roadmap for scalable SaaS and enterprise-grade products that align with EY’s strategic priorities and deliver measurable business impact. Ensure deep understanding of client needs, competitive landscape, and market trends to shape differentiated, high-value propositions. Translate complex AI technologies into intuitive, user-centric functionalities that simplify workflows and elevate user experience. Build, lead, and mentor a team of product managers, instilling a culture of innovation, accountability, and excellence in product thinking. Partner with engineering, design, and business teams to deliver high-quality, reliable, and usable products within defined timelines. Champion usability and functional simplicity, ensuring products go beyond automation to create tangible business unlocks. Communicate priorities clearly, align stakeholders across functions, and ensure transparency on progress, risks, and dependencies. Key Requirements: Proven track record in designing and executing scalable SaaS products, balancing user needs and market demands. Strong leadership experience managing and mentoring product teams in complex, multi-stakeholder environments. Deep understanding of AI technologies and their practical application in product design and automation. Exceptional communication and collaboration skills with the ability to translate technical complexity into business clarity. Demonstrated success in driving adoption, usability, and measurable business outcomes through thoughtful product design. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a bias for action and ownership. 12–18 years of total experience with at least 5+ years in senior product leadership roles. Why EY: At EY, we are reimagining how technology can create trust, transparency, and efficiency across industries. This role offers the opportunity to lead at the intersection of AI, design, and enterprise technology—building products that power the next phase of digital transformation for clients and the firm.

Skills And Attributes

To qualify for the role you must have

Qualification

  • Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science or a technical degree
  • Master of Business Administration (optional)

Experience

  • Full Stack Development (4+ years)
  • Machine Learning (1+ years)
  • Product Management (8+ years)
  • Artificial Intelligence (1+ years)

What We Look For

People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

What We Offer

Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side-by-side with market-leading entrepreneurs, game-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. As an organization, we are investing more time, technology, and money than ever before in skills and learning for our people. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities.

EY is equally committed to being an inclusive employer, and we strive to achieve the right balance for our people—enabling us to deliver excellent client service while allowing our people to build their careers as well as focus on their wellbeing.

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

Join us in shaping the future with confidence. Apply Now

-  Job Type: Full Time Employment

What You'll Do



- Assess business value, develop business cases, and prioritize epics, stories, and themes aligned with product vision and strategic goals.
- Define and manage product deliveries, release plans, and feature scope in collaboration with platform leadership.
- Draft product objectives and strategies, leveraging data-driven insights for decision-making.
- Define and track KPIs; utilize analytics, A/B testing, and user feedback to refine product features.
- Convert functional specifications into actionable user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
- Own, maintain, and refine the product backlog; lead backlog grooming and sprint planning sessions.
- Manage release planning and track progress through development and QA phases in collaboration with the Scrum Master.
- Lead software gate reviews, including formal and informal handoffs.
- Collaborate with stakeholders on product visioning and concept development.
- Translate complex sprint outcomes and technical updates into business-friendly summaries.
- Act as the voice of the customer across engineering, UX, QA, and business teams.
- Proactively identify and escalate risks and impediments to program leadership.
- Ensure understanding of end-to-end customer experience, integrations, and technical dependencies.
- Drive continuous improvement in product development practices.
- Thrive in a collaborative, team-oriented culture with shared accountability.

Expertise You'll Bring



- Experience working as a Product Owner or in a similar role within software product development.
- Strong domain knowledge in Lending (LOS mandatory) and familiarity with LMS systems.
- Solid understanding of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban); SAFe experience is a plus.
- Proven ability to write clear user stories and translate business requirements into technical specifications.
- Hands-on experience collaborating with engineering, QA, UX, and cross-functional teams.
- Product Owner certification preferred; Scrum Master certification is an added advantage.
- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
- Advanced English communication skills (B2+ or higher).
- Prior experience in FinTech is a plus.

Benefits



-  Competitive salary and benefits package
-  Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
-  Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies

title: Senior Director - Product Design
descriptionHtml:
About Freshworks

Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.

There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.

Freshworks Inc. builds uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional employee and customer experiences. Our people-first approach to AI eliminates friction, helping businesses reduce complexity, lower cost-to-serve, and deliver faster, more human support through enterprise-grade yet easy-to-use CX and IT solutions. Nearly 75,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks to power their Employee Experience (EX) and Customer Experience (CX) operations.

Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.



Job Description

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Vision & Strategy: Define and drive the long-term design vision and strategy for integrated product portfolios.

  • User advocacy: Champion a deep understanding of users to ensure products are not just functional, but indispensable.

  • Cross-functional alignment: Collaborate with senior leadership in Product Management and Engineering to create a cohesive product strategy that anticipates market trends and user needs.

  • Executive communication: Evangelize the power of design thinking to solve complex challenges, presenting strategies and concepts to executive stakeholders.

  • Team leadership: Lead, mentor, and expand a world-class product design team, fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.

  • Design execution: Oversee the entire design lifecycle:

    • Partner with our Research leader to drive foundational understanding of our user base.

    • Partner with our PM leaders to drive a design strategy that is focused on revenue growth, and long term retention

    • Drive design excellence with your product design team. Ensure deliverables are of high quality.

    • Evangelize the work - Regular updates to leadership, as needed.

  • Design systems: Partner with the Design systems leader to ensure the system serves the product needs, and stays up to date with the innovations being made in the product portfolio.

  • Data-informed process: Insist on a data-informed approach, leveraging user analytics and qualitative research to validate hypotheses and measure the impact of design solutions.

  • Supercharge team velocity: Transform the design team's operational efficiency by embedding AI into daily workflows, moving beyond personal productivity to fundamentally accelerate how quickly and effectively the team delivers enterprise-grade experiences.

Impact You Will Create

  • Drive business growth: Transform business software from a blocker into a tool that propels growth by creating better experiences for customers and employees.

  • Simplify complexity: Make the most complex processes simple, intelligent, and efficient.

  • Drive customer retention: You are customer obsessed. You advocate for a deep understanding of our customers, the ICP, and their unmet needs. This advocacy should directly tie to improved CSAT and overall better retention (NDRR).

  • Enhance productivity: Eliminate friction to make employees more effective and organizations more productive.

  • Deliver actionable insights: Tackle the immense challenge of visualizing complex relationships, streamlining critical workflows, and turning massive amounts of operational data into actionable insights.

Champion AI-Augmented design operations: Act as an early adopter and evangelist for integrating AI technologies into the end-to-end design lifecycle. Operationalize AI tools for rapid prototyping, generative asset creation, and automated research analysis to exponentially increase your team's output and elevate the quality of their strategic work.



Qualifications

  • Experience: 15 years in product design, with at least 5 years managing managers and senior ICs (Principal, Sr.Staff level).

  • Domain Expertise: Extensive experience designing complex, data-rich enterprise SaaS applications.

  • Portfolio: A compelling portfolio that showcases leadership and design work on products involving complex workflows, data visualization, and systems thinking.

  • Leadership Record: Proven ability to build, manage, and motivate high-performing design teams in a competitive technology landscape.

  • Technical Acumen: A strong aptitude for understanding highly technical domains and the ability to translate that complexity into simple, intuitive user experiences.

  • AI Adoption Record: Demonstrable experience integrating AI tools and methodologies into a design team's workflow at scale, with clear examples of how this adoption improved the overall velocity and quality of the team's deliverables.

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, or a related field.



Additional Information

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business. Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.

title: Technical Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
Join the Team Modernizing Medicine

At ModMed, we’re not just building software—we’re reimagining the healthcare experience. Founded in 2010 by a practicing physician and a successful tech entrepreneur, we took a radically different approach: we hired doctors and taught them how to code. This "for doctors, by doctors" philosophy has allowed us to create an AI-enabled, specialty-specific cloud platform that places patients at the center of care.

A Culture of Excellence

When You Join ModMed, You’re Joining An Award-winning Team Recognized For Innovation And Employee Satisfaction. From Our Global Headquarters In Boca Raton Florida, And Extensive Employee Base In Hyderabad India, We Are a Team Of 4,500+ Passionate Problem-solvers On a Mission To Increase Medical Practice Success And Improve Patient Outcomes

  • Consistently ranked as a Top Place to Work
  • 2025 Globee Business Awards: Gold Globee for “Technology Team of the Year”
  • 2025 Black Book Awards: Ranked #1 EHR in 11 Specialties
  • Florida Venture Forum: Venture-Backed Company of the Year

We are growing fast, thinking big, and we are just getting started.

Ready to modernize medicine with us?

Job Description Summary

Technical Product Owner (Practice Management & AI Innovation)

Department: Product Management

The Mission

At ModMed, we are placing doctors and patients at the center of care through an intelligent, specialty-specific cloud platform. We are looking for a Technical Product Owner who doesn’t just manage a backlog, but actively shapes a world where software increases medical-practice success and improves patient outcomes.

The Role

You will serve as the strategic bridge between vision and velocity. As the liaison for our Practice Management product, you will leverage your deep medical billing knowledge and technical SQL skills to translate complex business needs into groundbreaking AI and automation-driven features.

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Drive the AI Revolution: You won't just follow a roadmap; you’ll elicit, analyze, and validate requirements for AI-driven logic and automation triggers that redefine the "modern" in ModMed.
  • Innovate Boldly: Translate business needs into high-fidelity functional requirements, including technical specifications and workflow diagrams that define the future of practice automation.
  • Save Time (Quantifiably): Identify operational bottlenecks using data-driven metrics and propose automation solutions that reduce manual effort and maximize financial outcomes for our clients.
  • Collaborate & Align: Partner with Engineering and Product Management to navigate the development lifecycle—addressing edge cases, ensuring scalability, and maintaining the highest standards of model accuracy.
  • Champion Change: Coordinate alpha/beta programs to gather the "voice of the customer," ensuring our AI initiatives create genuine Customer Delight before they hit the general market.
  • Think Big: Support release readiness by creating the "source of truth" documentation and training materials that empower our internal teams to succeed.

What You Bring

  • Healthcare Core: You have deep-rooted experience in Healthcare or Practice Management. You understand the heartbeat of a medical office.
  • Technical Edge: You are proficient in SQL for data validation and problem investigation. You enjoy "looking under the hood" to ensure data integrity.
  • The "Automation" Mindset: You are fascinated by AI capabilities and have the analytical rigor to design solutions that are compliant, scalable, and intuitive.
  • Communication Mastery: You can explain complex AI logic to a stakeholder and technical constraints to a designer without breaking a sweat.
  • Self-Starter DNA: You manage high-visibility projects with minimal supervision, balancing competing priorities with a focus on Doing Good.

Our Culture & Values

We believe in Aligning Passion with Purpose. At ModMed, you’ll find a team that moves fast, stays curious, and treats "fun" as a requirement, not an option.

  • Create Customer Delight in every feature.
  • Innovate Boldly, then make things happen.
  • Save Time for the people who save lives.

Why ModMed?

  • Innovation-First: Work on true AI/Automation projects that have a direct impact on healthcare providers.
  • Specialty-Specific: We don’t do "one size fits all"—we build intelligent tools for specific medical needs.
  • Growth: This is a high-visibility role with a direct line to product leadership and the opportunity to own a critical piece of our PM platform.

ModMed Benefits Highlight: At ModMed, we believe it’s important to offer a competitive benefits package designed to meet the diverse needs of our growing workforce. Eligible Modernizers can enroll in a wide range of benefits:

  • Meals & Snacks: Enjoy complimentary office lunches & dinners on select days and healthy snacks delivered to your desk,
  • Insurance Coverage: Comprehensive health, accidental, and life insurance plans, including coverage for family members, all at no cost to employees,
  • Allowances: Annual wellness allowance to support your well-being and productivity,
  • Earned, casual, and sick leaves to maintain a healthy work-life balance,
  • Bereavement leave for difficult times and extended medical leave options,
  • Paid parental leaves, including maternity, paternity, adoption, surrogacy, and abortion leave,
  • Celebration leave to make your special day even more memorable, and company-paid holidays to recharge and unwind.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: ModMed is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving imposters posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews," and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from ModMed without a formal interview process, and valid communications from our hiring team will come from our employees with a ModMed email address (first.lastname@modmed.com). Please check senders’ email addresses carefully. Additionally, ModMed will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you are receiving communications as described above, please report them to the FTC website.

ModMed Technologies India Private Limited follows a strict, merit-based and transparent recruitment process conducted only through official and authorized channels.

We Do Not

  • Charge any fees, processing charges, or amount by any nomenclature, whether as a fee or deposit at any stage of the recruitment process;
  • Authorise any individual, employee, or third party to collect any such payments (regardless of nomenclature) to offer or facilitate or recruitment opportunities; or
  • Conduct hiring via informal messaging apps or personal email IDs.

All official communication is made only through verified channels, our website, and recognised recruitment platforms.

We strongly advise candidates not to share personal/financial information or make any payments in response to suspicious communications. Any such instances may be reported to us at hrcompliance@modmed.com .

ModMed Technologies India Private Limited will not be responsible for any loss arising from fraudulent or unauthorised communications.

title: IT Product Owner Open Text
descriptionHtml:
About Olympus

We are an equal opportunities employer and we are committed to ensuring that no applicant or employee receives less favorable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions or requirements which cannot be shown.


The job is conducted in line with our Core Values which are: Patient Focus, Integrity, Innovation, Impact and Empathy. Olympus is an equal opportunities employer championing a culture of equality, diversity and inclusion embedded throughout the organization and workforce


Job Summary

We are looking for with 8+ years of experience and expertise in OpenText Exstream / StreamServe to design, build, and operate enterprise output management solutions.This role combines architecture, development, and operational responsibilities, requiring active involvement in document template design, data processing, and output distribution, along with governance of service providers and global platforms.


PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design and implement end-to-end output management solutions using OpenText Exstream / StreamServe for SAP solutions
  • Actively develop and maintain document templates, workflows, and composition logic.
  • Implement and support operations in OpenText Extstream/ Streamserve with core components Communications builder / Design Center for template design and layout development.
  • StoryTeller – document composition and business logic implementation
  • Control Center – job scheduling, monitoring, and administrationXMLIn / StreamIn – input data parsing and transformation XMLOut – output structuring and deliveryDocument Broker – job routing and orchestration
  • Design and generate outputs in PDF, PCL,XML(e-invoice) and email .
  • Configure and optimize multi-channel delivery mechanismsWork closely with SAP teams on SAP SmartForms, SAP Script and SAP Print Management
  • Implement and troubleshoot data extraction and integration between SAP and Exstream using Dm sender Implement and manage document archiving using EASY Archive
  • Manage and configure archive link in SAPWork closely with service providers and vendors on delivery and operations.
  • C# program to get the pdf signed with Seal ( using digicert)


TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES

  • Strong hands-on experience with OpenText Exstream (16.x) and/ StreamServe
  • Expertise in:
  • Communications Builder / Design Center
  • StoryTeller – document composition and business logic implementation
  • scripting and document logic
  • XMLIn, StreamIn, XMLOut
  • Control Center
  • Ability to design and build complex document templates and layouts
  • Hands-on experience generating and managing PDF, PCL, XML(e-invoicing) and Email outputs
  • Working knowledge of SAP smartforms, SAP Script and SAP print management
  • Strong experience with XML, data transformation, and structured formats , knowledge of EDI formats(Peppol, xRechnung)
  • Proficiency in SQL and scripting using PowerShell & C#
  • Experience with EASY Archive or similar solutions for document archiving
  • Strong troubleshooting skills in document generation, formatting, and delivery issues


Other Competencies (Behavioral, Leadership)

  • Strategic mindset - Seeing ahead to future possibilities and translating them into breakthrough strategies.
  • Cultivates innovation - Creating new and better ways for the organization to be successful.
  • Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
  • Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.
  • Balances stakeholders - Anticipating and balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders.
  • Drives engagement - Creating a climate where people are motivated to do their best to help the organization achieve its objectives.
  • Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.
  • Develops talent - Developing people to meet both their career goals and the organization’s goals.
  • Instills trust - Gaining the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity.

Situational adaptability - Adapting approach and demeanor in real time to match the shifting demands of different situations.


Experience

Specialized experience

  • Minimum 5–8 years’ experience in IT product management, business analysis, or a comparable role.
  • Good knowledge of ITIL, ITSM, project management, and risk management.
  • Strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and communication skills.
  • Experience with product lifecycle management and agile methodologies such as SCRUM and SAFe.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

title: IT Product Owner [T500-26568]
descriptionHtml:
About Costco Wholesale:

Costco Wholesale is a multi-billion-dollar global retailer with warehouse club operations in eleven countries. They provide a wide selection of quality merchandise, plus the convenience of specialty departments and exclusive member services, all designed to make shopping a pleasurable experience for their members.


About Costco Wholesale India:

At Costco Wholesale India, we foster a collaborative space, working to support Costco Wholesale in developing innovative solutions that improve members’ experiences and make employees’ jobs easier. Our employees play a key role in driving and delivering innovation to establish IT as a core competitive advantage for Costco Wholesale.


Job Description:

Position Summary:

Global Digital Experience (GDX) is looking for a passionate and experienced Product Owner to shape the future of retail at a global scale. At Costco, we're building the next generation of retail technology, and we're looking for talented individuals to drive our digital transformation.

Costco is a company that not only delivers exceptional value to millions of members worldwide but also deeply values its employees, fosters a culture of innovation, and offers genuine opportunities for career growth.


The Costco GDX team is looking for a talented individual to strategically define, guide, and champion the products that power our multi-billion dollar eCommerce business. In this role, you'll be working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, focusing heavily on defining the product strategy, roadmap and backlog. You will have the opportunity to make a tangible impact on millions of members globally within a rapidly expanding eCommerce landscape.


You'll have direct responsibility for:

  • Delivering innovative capabilities that enhance the member experience across various digital touchpoints.
  • Driving product strategy and roadmap in partnership with the Business stakeholders and Product Management.
  • Ensuring the longevity, scalability and quality of our systems through continuous improvement, comprehensive documentation, and meticulous profiling.


Job Duties / Essential Functions:

  • Collaborates with Product Managers and technology stakeholders (Engineers, Architects) to strategically align the product backlog with the overall Product vision and strategy.
  • Strategically prioritizes product features, balancing technical debt, platform improvements, architectural enablers with user-facing features.
  • Defines and communicates the minimum viable product (MVP) based on business value and technical feasibility.
  • Translates IT and Business Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) into actionable sprint goals.
  • Creates user stories with clear acceptance criteria and metrics that establish the criteria for delivery readiness
  • Leads and is accountable for the end-to-end delivery of the product backlog.
  • Drives cross-team collaboration to align on dependencies and timelines.

title: Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Solinas, a deep-tech startup incubated at IIT Madras, is India’s pioneering asset management venture transforming the water and sanitation sector. Recognized and commended by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Solinas is on a mission to tackle pressing challenges such as manual scavenging, water accessibility, and the prevention of floods and sewer overflows. At the core of our vision lies a commitment to developing homegrown, affordable robotics and AI solutions for pipeline inspections, manhole and septic tank cleaning, and underground asset management.


Since 2018, we have transformed operations across 30+ cities, earning accolades such as Best On-Campus Startup by the Economic Times, an appearance on Shark Tank India, and partnerships with industry leaders like Ashirvad Pipes and The/Nudge Institute. On the global stage, Solinas has been named Best Southeast Asian Startup by Imagine H2O — a testament to our innovation, impact, and purpose driven growth


About the role

As Product Owner for Swasth AI, you'll sit at the intersection of engineering, field operations, and customer impact. You'll own the product backlog, translate real-world infrastructure problems into actionable user stories, and work hand-in-hand with our engineering team to ship features that utilities and city planners actually use. This is not a coordination role. You'll be a decision-maker — setting priorities, challenging assumptions, and holding the bar for quality and user value.


What You'll Own

Product Strategy & Backlog

✓ Own and continuously refine the product backlog, ensuring every item is well-defined, prioritized, and tied to real user value

✓ Translate field visits, customer conversations, and data into crisp epics and user stories the team can act on immediately

✓ Define and track KPIs that actually measure whether the product is working — not just whether it shipped Cross-Functional Leadership

✓ Be the connective tissue between engineering, operations, sales, and the end users in the field

✓ Facilitate sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives that energize the team rather than drain it

✓ Communicate product direction clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences — including leadership Delivery & Execution

✓ Drive Agile ceremonies using SAFe or Scrum, ensuring the team moves fast without breaking trust

✓ Proactively surface risks and blockers — and come with a proposed path forward, not just a flag

✓ Travel to customer sites when needed to gather ground-truth requirements; infrastructure problems can't always be understood from a desk


What We're Looking For

Must-Have

✓ 3–5 years of experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager in a product-based company or startup ✓ Proven ability to own a backlog end-to-end in an Agile environment (SAFe, Scrum, or Kanban)

✓ Strong communication skills — you write clearly, present confidently, and listen carefully

✓ Data-driven mindset: you make decisions backed by evidence, not gut instinct alone

✓ Technical acumen sufficient to have credible conversations with engineers about architecture and trade-offs


Great to Have

✓ Experience with pipeline, utilities, water/wastewater, or smart city infrastructure

✓ Product Owner or Project Management certification (CSPO, SAFe PO/PM, PMI-ACP)

✓ Background in product marketing or go-to-market strategy ✓ Experience managing multiple products simultaneously


Why Solinas

✓ Work on technology that prevents manual scavenging and saves lives

✓ Direct access to leadership: you'll work closely with the leadership team and have real influence on product direction

✓ High-growth startup with proven traction: 30+ cities, multiple national awards, Shark Tank India alumni ✓ Competitive salary with performance-linked incentives and comprehensive healthcare

✓ A team of engineers, roboticists, and domain experts who take the mission seriously — and have fun doing it

title: Product Delivery Director - Equities & Prime
descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Bring your expertise to shape and enhance the journey of products from inception through delivery. Lead impactful initiatives that improve how products are delivered, creating greater efficiency and consistency for clients. In this role, you will mentor a small, high-performing team while driving execution across the product lifecycle. You will operate in a dynamic environment, turning complex challenges into opportunities for continuous improvement. This is an opportunity to deliver scalable solutions that strengthen business and client outcomes.

As a Product Delivery Director at JPMorgan Chase within the Commercial & Investment Bank, Post Trade Technology team, you lead initiatives that optimize product delivery and improve operational outcomes. You are responsible for driving product delivery, payment controls, and operational readiness across Equities and Prime businesses. You partner with cross-functional teams to deliver solutions that are scalable, efficient, and aligned with business priorities. You ensure strong execution discipline while managing risks, dependencies, and timelines. You also contribute to enhancing delivery practices to enable consistent value creation. This role focuses on strengthening delivery governance and control frameworks across product and technology teams. You will work closely with stakeholders across business, operations, and technology to support critical initiatives within Post Trade activities. The role includes ownership of delivery processes, change management, and readiness for product launches. You will also guide and mentor few members while maintaining a hands-on approach to execution, as role operates in individual capacity. Success in this role requires strong domain expertise, collaboration, and the ability to operate effectively in a complex, matrixed environment.

Job Responsibilities

  • Design and support implementation of the Payment Controls strategy for Equities and Prime across Post Trade Technology
  • Lead end-to-end product delivery activities, including intake, dependency management, release management, operationalization, and performance reporting
  • Drive delivery governance and feasibility assessments, ensuring alignment with business priorities and technical capabilities
  • Own and enhance the change management framework, ensuring adherence to risk, controls, compliance, and regulatory requirements
  • Maintain visibility over timelines, dependencies, and risks, proactively addressing blockers and ensuring appropriate resourcing
  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders across Technology, Operations, and Business teams to ensure seamless execution
  • Mentor teams across engineering, product & delivery, driving best practices in delivery, resource planning, and deployment efficiency
  • Identify and implement process improvements to enhance delivery efficiency and coordination

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • 10+ years of experience in product delivery, program management, or technology delivery roles
  • 5+ years of experience within Investment Banking in Equities, Prime, Custody, or Payments
  • Proven track record of delivering complex products/programs and solving large-scale business problems
  • Experience designing scalable, high-availability solutions with strong controls frameworks
  • Strong understanding of product development lifecycle, technical design, and data analytics
  • Demonstrated expertise in operational management, change readiness, and delivery governance
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, matrixed, global environment
  • Recognized as a subject matter expert or thought leader within product delivery or post-trade domain
  • Experience driving large-scale transformation or control initiatives
  • Familiarity with risk and regulatory frameworks within global banking environments

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Recognized as a subject matter expert or thought leader within product delivery or post-trade domain
  • Experience driving large-scale transformation or control initiatives
  • Familiarity with risk and regulatory frameworks within global banking environments

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

title: Director, Platform Product Management
descriptionHtml:
FICO (NYSE: FICO) is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!

The Opportunity

We are seeking a strategic and technically grounded product leader to serve as Director of Platform Product Management – Infrastructure. This role will define and execute the product strategy for core infrastructure capabilities that power enterprise platforms and applications. The infrastructure platform serves both internal and external customers, enabling scalable, secure, and resilient systems.

What You’ll Contribute

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for infrastructure platform capabilities including compute, storage, networking, cloud services, and infrastructure automation.
  • Collaborate with infrastructure engineering, architecture, operations, and security teams to deliver solutions that meet performance, availability, scalability, and compliance requirements.
  • Drive initiatives that improve infrastructure availability, performance, cost efficiency, and defect reduction, with clear KPIs and continuous monitoring.
  • Champion observability and monitoring practices to ensure visibility into infrastructure health and performance.
  • Advocate for secure-by-design principles and ensure infrastructure services meet enterprise security and governance standards.
  • Partner with internal product and application teams to ensure infrastructure services are reliable, scalable, and aligned with evolving business needs.
  • Prioritize infrastructure investments based on business impact, risk, and technical feasibility.
  • Communicate product vision, strategy, and progress to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Stay ahead of industry trends in cloud infrastructure, automation, and platform engineering to inform strategy.


What We’re Seeking

  • 15+ years of industry experience in technology, with at least 10 years in product management roles.
  • Proven success in managing infrastructure platform products at scale.
  • Deep understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP), virtualization, containerization (Kubernetes, Docker), and networking.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible), observability platforms (e.g., Prometheus, Datadog), and security frameworks.
  • Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence without direct authority.
  • Experience in financial services or other regulated industries highly desired.
  • Deep experience with compliance standards, data center operations, and hybrid cloud environments.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Bachelor/Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field. MBA or equivalent business education.


Our Offer to You

  • An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.
  • The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
  • Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.
  • An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.


Why Make a Move to FICO?

At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.

FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:

  • Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.
  • Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.
  • Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score.


Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!

Learn more about how you can fulfil your potential at www.fico.com/Careers

FICO promotes a culture of inclusion and seeks to attract a diverse set of candidates for each job opportunity. We are an equal employment opportunity employer and we’re proud to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all candidates without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Research has shown that women and candidates from underrepresented communities may not apply for an opportunity if they don’t meet all stated qualifications. While our qualifications are clearly related to role success, each candidate’s profile is unique and strengths in certain skill and/or experience areas can be equally effective. If you believe you have many, but not necessarily all, of the stated qualifications we encourage you to apply.

Information submitted with your application is subject to the FICO Privacy policy at https://www.fico.com/en/privacy-policy

title: AI Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
AI Product Owner

Work mode: Remote

Notice period: Immediate joiners


So, what’s the role all about?

We are seeking an AI Product Owner to own and drive end-to-end internal AI initiatives across NiCE, turning AI from experimentation into measurable productivity gains. You will be the single accountable owner for internal AI transformation solutions that fundamentally change how core processes work across IT, HR, Finance, Sales, and other business functions. You will lead initiatives where AI agents significantly automate end-to-end processes (e.g., recruitment, finance operations, internal IT workflows), partnering with our internal AI delivery teams and business stakeholders to move from idea to live, adopted, value-generating AI solutions.


How will you make an impact?


You will own the full lifecycle of cross-functional AI initiatives: from opportunity framing through delivery, adoption, and measured outcomes. You will redesign business processes, translate business needs into actionable AI initiatives, and coordinate delivery with the IT AI Center of Excellence and business stakeholders.

This is a high-impact role for someone who combines strong business analysis with project leadership, thrives on driving concrete outcomes under ambiguity, and is energized by leading AI transformation across multiple business areas.



Project Ownership & Accountability

  • Own the full lifecycle of cross-functional AI initiatives, from opportunity framing through production rollout, adoption, and measured impact
  • Act as the single accountable owner for each AI transformation solution, with dedicated focus and clear lines of accountability
  • Drive concrete outcomes even when the solution is evolving or exploratory at the start; manage risks, dependencies, and stakeholder alignment proactively

Business Process Leadership

  • Analyze business processes deeply; identify where AI agents can automate, accelerate, or rethink existing work
  • Translate business needs into actionable AI initiatives with clear scope, success metrics, owners, and timelines
  • Partner with Finance, HR, IT, Sales, and other functions to redesign processes around agent-driven automation
  • Work hand-in-hand with the IT AI Center of Excellence

Outcomes & Impact

  • Partner with the AI analysts to define and report measurable impact: hours saved, cycle-time reduction, deflection, adoption, and ROI
  • Ensure every initiative reaches production with documented handover to operations and ongoing ownership


Have you got what it takes?

  • Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Information Systems or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience as a technical project manager/product manager with proven business analysis capabilities, of which at least 1 year was hands-on with AI projects
  • Familiarity with Anthropic Claude, Microsoft Copilot Studio, or similar agent platforms
  • Solid understanding of AI agents, automation, and how AI reshapes the way processes are designed
  • Experience with leading complex, cross-functional projects, ideally combining transformation, automation, or digital programs
  • Demonstrated experience leading products that change how a process works, not only deliver software

  • Skills & Competencies:

    • Analyst + PM hybrid: strong business process analysis combined with product leadership - able to map a process end-to-end and drive its transformation
    • Comfort leading initiatives where the solution is evolving; able to drive toward concrete outcomes under ambiguity
    • Strong stakeholder management across business and technology functions, up to executive level
    • Excellent written and verbal communication; full professional fluency in English


    Regards,

    Aravindhan

    9360366455

title: Product Owner (Client Experience)
descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Owner (Client Experience) based in India.

This role focuses on shaping and improving the post-payment experience for a global digital product used by millions of customers worldwide. You will be responsible for ensuring that paying users quickly reach meaningful value by successfully connecting and engaging with relevant matches. The position sits at the intersection of product strategy, user behavior, and data-driven optimization, with a strong emphasis on activation and customer success. You will work in a fast-paced, international environment alongside cross-functional teams including analytics, design, and engineering. The goal is to reduce friction in discovery and matching flows while increasing user satisfaction and engagement. This is a high-impact role where your decisions directly influence user retention and perceived product value across multiple global markets.

Accountabilities

  • Own and continuously improve the post-payment customer journey across core product experiences, ensuring users reach meaningful engagement quickly and consistently.
  • Increase user activation by helping paying customers find high-quality matches and sustain early communication within the first week of use.
  • Identify friction points in discovery, recommendation, and matching flows, and design solutions to improve relevance and user satisfaction.
  • Optimize the quality and personalization of offers, invites, and recommendations based on user behavior and preferences.
  • Define and refine customer segmentation strategies to tailor experiences to different user needs and expectations.
  • Collaborate closely with analytics, engineering, and design teams to test hypotheses, measure impact, and iterate on solutions.
  • Develop engagement and reactivation mechanics, including personalization, gamification, and communication tools to improve retention and value realization.

Requirements

  • Strong experience in B2C product management, ideally in platforms with complex discovery, matching, or recommendation systems.
  • Proven track record of improving user activation, onboarding, or time-to-value in consumer-facing digital products.
  • Solid understanding of customer journey design, particularly in post-payment or subscription-based environments.
  • Experience working with data-driven product development, including experimentation, A/B testing, and behavioral analysis.
  • Ability to design and improve segmentation, personalization, and recommendation logic.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify core user problems beyond surface-level feature requests.
  • Experience working with high-choice environments where users navigate multiple offers, options, or pathways.
  • Fluent Russian is required.

Benefits

  • Fully remote work opportunity.
  • 28 calendar days of annual vacation.
  • 7 wellness days per year for rest and personal needs without using sick leave.
  • Annual training and development support (50% coverage) for courses, conferences, and professional events.
  • English language learning discounts for employees.

  • Internal gamified recognition system with rewards redeemable for merchandise, experiences, and team activities.
  • Referral bonuses of up to $5,000 for successful candidate recommendations.

title: Senior product Owner
descriptionHtml:
The Senior Product Owner works to fulfill the strategic product roadmap established by the Product Management leadership team and meet business objectives. The person in this position manages multiple teams and backlogs for more than one product and/or for more complex products. This role is responsible for defining the detailed product deliverables. The Senior Product Owner must have a firm understanding of the business domain and product needs taking into account multiple types of users utilizing each solution. This position works closely with engineering on the specifications to ensure their Agile teams have all of the information needed to deliver a product that provides maximum value to the users.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with Product Managers to understand the market demands, priorities, and overall product strategy.
  • Partner with UX and Product Managers on market research efforts to understand and prioritize customer needs.
  • Work with one or more engineering teams to deliver timely, quality releases that provide high business value and exceed customer expectations.
  • Flexibility to support more than one product within a portfolio, potentially across value streams
  • Translate product strategy into detailed requirements and prototypes
  • Work with the Product Manager and Agile team to define the scope included in a release.
  • Understand user personas and partner with UX to develop
  • Create detailed specifications/requirements for the product features so they are clearly understood by the development team.
  • Write user stories and establish acceptance criteria in collaboration with the team.
  • Actively participate in PI planning, product sprints and daily stand-up meetings
  • Research and clarify details as the team develops the application
  • Be aware of customer commitments in order to communicate internally to assist with managing team expectations
  • Manage dependencies in and across sprints and releases
  • Work with the Agile team to manage and prioritize the backlog to ensure alignment with changing business needs.
  • Prioritize support work as needed
  • Assist with system status communication and escalation as needed including customer communication
  • Perform demos to all stakeholders on a regular basis
  • Keep stakeholders apprised of progress and incorporate their feedback
  • Understand project budgets, scope and timelines and work to maintain a balance
  • Use metrics and feedback to improve team and organization processes, best practices, performance, and delivery
  • May provide work direction or guidance to colleagues with less experience
  • Act as a product champion within the company

Skills Required

  • 7+ years’ proven experience as a Quality Engineer.
  • Experience with testing tools such as WebDriverIO/ any UI Automation tool , Postman, ReadyAPI / RestSharp/ any API automation tool.
  • Proficiency in languages like TypeScript, Groovy, or Java.
  • Extensive experience testing APIs/web services (REST, SOAP, etc.) using Postman.
  • Knowledge of AWS services (S3, Athena, DynamoDB, Kubernetes, Secrets Manager).
  • Experience with test management tools like Azure DevOps and Zephyr.
  • Proven experience working in Agile (Scrum/Kanban) environments.
  • Experience using GitHub for version control.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams and Strong problem-solving skills and a continuous learning mindset with a willingness to adapt to new technologies.

title: Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Technology…or technology that breathes life into work? SHL, People Science. People Answers.

Are you a seasoned Product Owner with a flair for innovation? Are you ready to shape the future of talent assessment and empower organizations to unlock their full potential? If so, we want you to be a part of the SHL Team! As a Product Owner, you will be part of a Scrum squad, responsible for prioritizing the product backlog to maximize value for a defined area of our HR SaaS product. You will work closely with the development team to refine user stories, align with customer and stakeholder needs, and represent the voice of the customer. This role is ideal for candidates with a background in business analysis or related fields..

An excellent benefit package is offered in a culture where career development, with ongoing manager guidance, collaboration, flexibility, diversity, and inclusivity are all intrinsic to our culture.  There is a huge investment in SHL currently so there’s no better time to become a part of something transformational.

What You Will Be Doing

Backlog Ownership: Own and maintain the product backlog for the assigned Scrum squad, ensuring it is well‑groomed and aligned with user and stakeholder needs.

  • Story Definition: Create clear user stories with well‑defined acceptance criteria and provide ongoing clarification to the development team.
  • Prioritization: Prioritize backlog items based on business value, customer feedback, and strategic direction from the Product Head and Senior Product Owner.
  • Scrum Collaboration: Actively participate in all Scrum ceremonies and support the team during sprint planning and execution.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Gather feedback from stakeholders and users, incorporating insights into the backlog and maintaining transparency on progress and goals.
  • Strategic Alignment: Collaborate with the Senior Product Owner and Product Head to support the product strategy, roadmap, and overall direction.
  • Customer & Process Focus: Build deep customer understanding, assist with product documentation, and contribute to continuous improvement of team processes.

Essential

What we are looking for from you:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field (e.g. Business, IT) or equivalent experience.
  • Proficiency with collaboration tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence, Miro)
  • Experience with wireframing tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch).
  • 1-3 years of experience in a Business Analyst, or other relevant business role with exposure to software development.
  • Experience with AI-powered software is a plus.
  • Experience working with Data for analytic purposes is a plus

Desirable

  • Communication & Teamwork: Clear communication and effective collaboration in cross‑functional teams.
  • Execution Skills: Strong organization, time management, and problem‑solving abilities.

Get In Touch

Find out how this one-off opportunity can help you to achieve your career goals by making an application to our knowledgeable and friendly Talent Acquisition team. Choose a new path with SHL.

#CareersAtSHL #SHLHiringTalent #ProductOwner #Product #Technology #Innovation

About Us

  • We unlock the possibilities of businesses through the power of people, science and technology.
  • We started this industry of people insight more than 40 years ago and continue to lead the market with powerhouse product launches, ground-breaking science and business transformation.
  • When you inspire and transform people’s lives, you will experience the greatest business outcomes possible. SHL’s products insights, experiences, and services can help achieve growth at scale.

What SHL Can Offer You

Diversity, equity, inclusion and accessibility are key threads in the fabric of SHL’s business and culture (find out more about DEI and accessibility at SHL )

  • Employee benefits package that takes care of you and your family.
  • Support, coaching, and on-the-job development to achieve career success
  • A fun and flexible workplace where you’ll be inspired to do your best work (find out more LifeAtSHL )
  • The ability to transform workplaces around the world for others.

SHL is an equal opportunity employer. We support and encourage applications from a diverse range of candidates. We can, and do make adjustments to make sure our recruitment process is as inclusive as possible.
