descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Principal Product Owner (Technology Driven Role) based in India.

In this role, you will act as a key bridge between business stakeholders and engineering teams, driving the discovery, definition, and delivery of high-impact digital and technology-enabled products. You will shape product direction by translating complex business needs into clear, actionable requirements, ensuring alignment across technical and non-technical teams. This position requires strong ownership of end-to-end product lifecycle activities, from ideation and requirements gathering through delivery and validation. You will work closely with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment to prioritize features, manage dependencies, and optimize delivery outcomes. The role is highly strategic, combining product thinking, process optimization, and technology understanding to enable scalable digital solutions. You will also play a critical role in improving business processes through automation and modern platform capabilities. This is an opportunity to influence enterprise-level product transformation initiatives in a fast-paced, global delivery environment.

Accountabilities

  • Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and software delivery teams, ensuring alignment on product goals and priorities.
  • Lead requirements gathering sessions, workshops, and stakeholder interviews to capture and translate business needs into user stories, functional specifications, and process flows.
  • Manage, refine, and prioritize product requirements in collaboration with product management and cross-functional teams.
  • Analyze complex business processes and identify opportunities for automation, optimization, and reengineering.
  • Define and document system dependencies, integration flows, and data mapping requirements across platforms.
  • Collaborate with project managers to plan scope, timelines, resources, and delivery milestones while managing risks and issues.
  • Support Agile delivery by grooming backlogs, facilitating sprint planning, and ensuring clear communication across teams.
  • Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and ensure delivered solutions meet business expectations and quality standards.
  • Work closely with QA teams to validate functionality and ensure alignment with specifications.
  • Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in product ownership and business analysis.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar IT product delivery role.
  • Strong experience working with web and mobile platforms, including API-driven architectures.
  • Solid understanding and hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Proven ability to lead requirement gathering sessions and translate business needs into technical and functional documentation.
  • Experience creating wireframes, mockups, and prototypes to support solution design.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to evaluate and improve complex business processes.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong stakeholder management and ability to work across multiple teams and priorities in high-pressure environments.
  • Highly self-motivated, proactive, and capable of working independently with minimal supervision.
  • Strong collaboration skills and experience working in cross-functional, team-oriented environments.

title: AES - DE - Agile - Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
Job Description

As a Product Owner, you will be responsible for translating business objectives into actionable product features. This role involves managing the product roadmap, collaborating closely with stakeholders, and ensuring smooth execution. Your expertise in Agile methodologies and stakeholder management will be key to delivering high-quality products.

Responsibilities

  • Own and manage the product roadmap, ensuring timely and effective delivery.
  • Refine the backlog, prioritize tasks, and write clear user stories with measurable acceptance criteria.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, development teams, and QA to deliver exceptional features.
  • Present clear, focused updates to stakeholders and leadership, keeping them informed.
  • Act as the primary liaison, fostering a shared understanding between business and technology teams.
  • Synthesize stakeholder inputs into well-defined priorities and decisions.

title: Product Management Director
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Product

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About Employee Service At Salesforce

Salesforce Employee Service powers next-generation internal support and service management. Our platform enables organizations to deliver seamless IT and HR experiences to their workforce by:

  • Automating internal service processes and streamlining cross-departmental workflows.
  • Leveraging AI to intelligently mine knowledge, resolve employee inquiries instantly, and power autonomous, agent-driven interactions.
  • Delivering exceptional employee experiences with intelligent case routing, predictive insights, and real-time collaboration tools that boost enterprise productivity.

About The Role

We’re seeking a visionary Director of Product Management to lead our next-generation AI initiatives and drive the strategy of AI-first, collaboration-first, and platform-centric innovations across our Employee Service portfolio (spanning IT Service Management and HR Service Delivery). This role is critical to building enterprise-grade internal service solutions that empower employees, IT helpdesks, and HR teams at scale.

You will lead the charge in transitioning our employee service paradigm from reactive ticketing to proactive, autonomous workflows. You will build and scale enterprise-grade Agentic AI systems, determining how autonomous agents collaborate with human employees, integrating state-of-the-art LLMs, and defining the future of AI-first work.

As the owner of the AI roadmap, you will translate the latest industry trends—spanning Generative AI and Predictive Machine Learning—into scalable product features. Working cross-functionally with engineering, data science, UX, sales, and marketing, you will ensure our AI solutions remain cutting-edge, secure, and highly impactful for transforming how enterprises support their workforce.

What You’ll Do

  • Define Product Strategy: Own the product vision and strategy for AI-driven capabilities within Employee Service (IT and HR domains), ensuring alignment with broader business goals.
  • Agentic AI Leadership: Lead the conceptualization and delivery of Agentic AI workflows, enabling autonomous, task-oriented AI agents to resolve internal IT tickets and HR requests.
  • Architectural Strategy: Drive product and architectural decisions around LLM integration, RAG pipelines, and agent orchestration frameworks. You will own the trade-offs between model performance, latency, cost, and context window optimization.
  • AI Trust, Safety & Evals: Design robust evaluation frameworks for AI agents to measure accuracy, mitigate hallucinations, manage prompt injection risks, and maintain enterprise-grade data privacy.
  • AI-First UX: Define the UX paradigms for human-in-the-loop (HITL) interactions, ensuring seamless handoffs between autonomous agents and employees/IT Teams.
  • Customer Discovery & Integration: Engage directly with enterprise customers to understand complex pain points, specifically focusing on how they discover, adopt, and integrate AI applications into their internal IT, HR, and custom enterprise ecosystems (e.g., via API-based integrations and secure server environments).
  • Cross-Functional Execution: Collaborate deeply with engineering, data science, and UX teams to build scalable, intuitive, and high-performance AI solutions, driving prioritization and trade-offs.
  • Go-to-Market Alignment: Partner with sales, marketing, and enablement teams to define GTM strategies, positioning, and messaging to ensure successful product launches and market adoption.
  • Executive Communication: Regularly present product updates, AI strategies, and measurable results to C-suite leadership and external partners, ensuring continuous alignment.
  • Data-Driven Iteration: Leverage data-driven insights to continuously improve product offerings, tracking employee adoption, operational cost savings, and market share expansion.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: 14+ years of product management experience in enterprise SaaS, with a demonstrated track record of taking an Agentic product from 0-to-1 and scaling it in a production environment.
  • AI/ML Expertise: Hands-on familiarity with LLM orchestration (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex), embedding models, vector databases, and designing autonomous agent loops (planning, tool use, reflection). You deeply understand the trade-offs between different foundation models and fine-tuning vs. RAG approaches. Strong working knowledge of predictive ML models and data pipelines.
  • Technical Fluency: Experience with AI evaluation techniques (e.g., LLM-as-a-judge) and continuous model improvement cycles based on human feedback. Ability to engage deeply with engineering and data science teams on architectural tradeoffs, model selection, and performance metrics.
  • Strategic Execution: Proven track record of developing and executing comprehensive, multi-quarter product roadmaps that drive measurable business impact.
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional executive presence with the ability to navigate stakeholder alignment and articulate complex AI concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Preferred Domain Knowledge: A proven ability to build scalable AI/LLM products is essential. Familiarity with Salesforce AI capabilities (e.g., Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, Data Cloud) and prior experience in IT Service Management (ITSM), HR Service Delivery, or Employee Workflows are highly preferred but not mandatory.

Why Join Us?

  • Work on cutting-edge AI-powered solutions that transform internal support experiences for enterprises.
  • Collaborate with a world-class team in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Shape the future of intelligent employee service management and drive meaningful impact by solving real organizational challenges at scale.
  • Be part of a culture of innovation, collaboration, personal growth and continuous learning.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

“Capco, a Wipro company, is a global technology and management consulting firm. Awarded with Consultancy of the year in the British Bank Award and has been ranked Top 100 Best Companies for Women in India 2022 by Avtar & Seramount. With our presence across 32 cities across globe, we support 100+ clients across banking, financial and Energy sectors. We are recognized for our deep transformation execution and delivery.

WHY JOIN CAPCO?

You will work on engaging projects with the largest international and local banks, insurance companies, payment service providers and other key players in the industry. The projects that will transform the financial services industry.

MAKE AN IMPACT

Innovative thinking, delivery excellence and thought leadership to help our clients transform their business. Together with our clients and industry partners, we deliver disruptive work that is changing energy and financial services.

#BEYOURSELFATWORK

Capco has a tolerant, open culture that values diversity, inclusivity, and creativity.

CAREER ADVANCEMENT

With no forced hierarchy at Capco, everyone has the opportunity to grow as we grow, taking their career into their own hands.

DIVERSITY & INCLUSION

We believe that diversity of people and perspective gives us a competitive advantage.

MAKE AN IMPACT

Job Description

Experience: 7+ Years

Notice Period: 30 Days

Handholding development and testing teams to ensure timely and effective sprint delivery

title: Director Product Operations
descriptionHtml:
At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We’re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Bartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape – but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform.

If you’re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you!

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk.

Role: Director of Product Operations

The Director of Product Operations role exists to define, drive adoption and accountability of an efficient software development lifecycle at Arctic Wolf. This individual will own codification of the product management outcomes through the SDLC, ensuring consistency in product management-specific documentation, standards, and training; owning the strategy and implementation for any product management specific SDLC tooling and to drive consistent adoption and accountability. This role will monitor the implementation of the SDLC to ensure the product management organization is consistently driving to the standard, identifying gaps, and driving solutions in collaboration with PM leaders.

The Director of Operations is a strategic and execution‑focused leader responsible for driving operational excellence across the organization. This role oversees cross‑functional processes, ensures alignment between product, engineering, and business teams, and establishes scalable operational frameworks that enable growth and efficiency. The Director of Operations will partner closely with senior leadership to define operational strategy, optimize performance, and ensure organizational readiness as the business evolves.

A key component of this role is serving as a subject matter expert (SME) in the Aha! product management platform or demonstrating significant experience with a comparable product management tool, ensuring strong transferable skills in product planning, roadmapping, workflow management, and cross‑team coordination.

Primary Responsibilities And Duties

  • Develop, implement, and continually refine operational strategies, processes, and systems that support organizational goals.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives that drive efficiency, operational alignment, and predictable delivery.
  • Establish and manage performance metrics, operational dashboards, and reporting frameworks to monitor progress and inform decision‑making.
  • Partner with Product Management, Engineering, and Program Management to streamline workflows, prioritize initiatives, and support successful execution of product roadmaps.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks and implement solutions that improve throughput, quality, and scalability.
  • Lead operational planning cycles, including annual planning, resourcing, and sequencing of strategic initiatives.
  • Standardize processes, documentation, and governance to ensure clarity, accountability, and operational consistency across teams.
  • Manage risk assessment and mitigation strategies, ensuring operational reliability.
  • Serve as the organizational subject matter expert in Aha! or a similar product management tool, enabling teams to drive adoption, optimize usage, and leverage data for decision‑making.
  • Support onboarding, training, and best‑practice integration for operations‑related tools and processes.
  • Influence and support change‑management efforts to ensure smooth integration of new systems, tools, and methodologies.
  • Influence
    • Provide scalable solutions, like recorded training, best practices, templates, targeted coaching to product managers to facilitate the creation of high quality epics throughout the product lifecycle; supporting clear understanding of problems, suggested implementations and success metrics, and an effective refinement process with engineering
    • Ensure product managers are creating and using effective, meaningful success metrics; In partnership with PMO, drive a process that regularly reviews deliverables against success criteria
    • Assist product management leaders with best practices and tactics to drive product manager involvement throughout the entire SDLC to enable consistent communication of value, rapid problem solving, and quick scope adjustment
    • Assist product management leaders with standard process for user acceptance test (beta, EAP, Design partners) and enabling cross-functional collaboration
    • Ensure Product Marketing are embedded early and often in the product development lifecycle and the software development lifecycle
    • Drive processes to enable high-impact UX engagement throughout the SDLC process so that UX time can be invested on the highest value work
    • Foster an environment with early and often cross-functional collaboration and involvement (IT, ProdSec, Legal, GTO, S2, etc)
    • Facilitate quick decision-making by acting as the point of contact for prioritization assistance
  • Own
    • Product Organization Fiscal Year Annual Operating Planning process
    • Product Organization Quarterly Business Review process
    • Product Development Process and tools– “Product Manager of the Product Management process and implementation”; identify hotspots in the process to address and identify coaching opportunities; Develop a cadence of spot-checking product management processes as teams move through the development process to identify areas of growth for the teams and undesired friction in the process
    • Identify opportunities to bring knowledge and data that provide value across all product management teams; implement ways to enable self-serve access to that knowledge and data
    • Implement and maintain a road-mapping process that allows for efficient support of greenlight process requirements and consistently communicates and delivers customer and stakeholder value
    • Own Product Management specific tooling (usage, contracting, mgmt); Drive consistent, standardized and efficient usage our tooling (Aha!, Jira, Confluence, XLS), determine what the right tool is for the outcome
    • Own the pieces of the SDLC with product involvement; enable a culture of continuous learning and improvement; monitor the effective implementation of the SDLC, identify opportunities for tooling, process and people improvements and drive a metrics-oriented view of the health of the PM components of the SDLC
    • Own and drive a set of metrics in support of the SDLC and at the discretion of the product SVP, to support the product lines as a whole function
    • Own the business case template and lifecycle – from pitch through launch, ensuring clear reporting against goals throughout the lifecycle
    • Own the product line strategy templates and lifecycle – Ensuring strategies include 3yr plan, where are you going, how you are going to win, supporting research; clear reporting against strategic goals for AWN

Key Skills

  • Strong operational strategy development and execution abilities
  • Exceptional Product Management Knowledge – This role is the Product Manager of the Product Management process; must have a deep, experiential knowledge of product management and be able to translate that experience into best practices, templates and standardization
  • Excellent cross-functional leadership, communication, and stakeholder‑management skills

Role: Director of Product Operations

The Director of Product Operations role exists to define, drive adoption and accountability of an efficient software development lifecycle at Arctic Wolf. The Director of Operations is a strategic and execution‑focused leader responsible for driving operational excellence across the organization. title: Product Management Director
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Product

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About Employee Service At Salesforce

Salesforce Employee Service powers next-generation internal support and service management. Our platform enables organizations to deliver seamless IT and HR experiences to their workforce by:

  • Automating internal service processes and streamlining cross-departmental workflows.
  • Leveraging AI to intelligently mine knowledge, resolve employee inquiries instantly, and power autonomous, agent-driven interactions.
  • Delivering exceptional employee experiences with intelligent case routing, predictive insights, and real-time collaboration tools that boost enterprise productivity.

About The Role

We’re seeking a visionary Director of Product Management to lead our next-generation AI initiatives and drive the strategy of AI-first, collaboration-first, and platform-centric innovations across our Employee Service portfolio (spanning IT Service Management and HR Service Delivery). This role is critical to building enterprise-grade internal service solutions that empower employees, IT helpdesks, and HR teams at scale.

You will lead the charge in transitioning our employee service paradigm from reactive ticketing to proactive, autonomous workflows. You will build and scale enterprise-grade Agentic AI systems, determining how autonomous agents collaborate with human employees, integrating state-of-the-art LLMs, and defining the future of AI-first work.

As the owner of the AI roadmap, you will translate the latest industry trends—spanning Generative AI and Predictive Machine Learning—into scalable product features. Working cross-functionally with engineering, data science, UX, sales, and marketing, you will ensure our AI solutions remain cutting-edge, secure, and highly impactful for transforming how enterprises support their workforce.

What You’ll Do

  • Define Product Strategy: Own the product vision and strategy for AI-driven capabilities within Employee Service (IT and HR domains), ensuring alignment with broader business goals.
  • Agentic AI Leadership: Lead the conceptualization and delivery of Agentic AI workflows, enabling autonomous, task-oriented AI agents to resolve internal IT tickets and HR requests.
  • Architectural Strategy: Drive product and architectural decisions around LLM integration, RAG pipelines, and agent orchestration frameworks. You will own the trade-offs between model performance, latency, cost, and context window optimization.
  • AI Trust, Safety & Evals: Design robust evaluation frameworks for AI agents to measure accuracy, mitigate hallucinations, manage prompt injection risks, and maintain enterprise-grade data privacy.
  • AI-First UX: Define the UX paradigms for human-in-the-loop (HITL) interactions, ensuring seamless handoffs between autonomous agents and employees/IT Teams.
  • Customer Discovery & Integration: Engage directly with enterprise customers to understand complex pain points, specifically focusing on how they discover, adopt, and integrate AI applications into their internal IT, HR, and custom enterprise ecosystems (e.g., via API-based integrations and secure server environments).
  • Cross-Functional Execution: Collaborate deeply with engineering, data science, and UX teams to build scalable, intuitive, and high-performance AI solutions, driving prioritization and trade-offs.
  • Go-to-Market Alignment: Partner with sales, marketing, and enablement teams to define GTM strategies, positioning, and messaging to ensure successful product launches and market adoption.
  • Executive Communication: Regularly present product updates, AI strategies, and measurable results to C-suite leadership and external partners, ensuring continuous alignment.
  • Data-Driven Iteration: Leverage data-driven insights to continuously improve product offerings, tracking employee adoption, operational cost savings, and market share expansion.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: 14+ years of product management experience in enterprise SaaS, with a demonstrated track record of taking an Agentic product from 0-to-1 and scaling it in a production environment.
  • AI/ML Expertise: Hands-on familiarity with LLM orchestration (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex), embedding models, vector databases, and designing autonomous agent loops (planning, tool use, reflection). You deeply understand the trade-offs between different foundation models and fine-tuning vs. RAG approaches. Strong working knowledge of predictive ML models and data pipelines.
  • Technical Fluency: Experience with AI evaluation techniques (e.g., LLM-as-a-judge) and continuous model improvement cycles based on human feedback. Ability to engage deeply with engineering and data science teams on architectural tradeoffs, model selection, and performance metrics.
  • Strategic Execution: Proven track record of developing and executing comprehensive, multi-quarter product roadmaps that drive measurable business impact.
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional executive presence with the ability to navigate stakeholder alignment and articulate complex AI concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Preferred Domain Knowledge: A proven ability to build scalable AI/LLM products is essential. Familiarity with Salesforce AI capabilities (e.g., Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, Data Cloud) and prior experience in IT Service Management (ITSM), HR Service Delivery, or Employee Workflows are highly preferred but not mandatory.

Why Join Us?

  • Work on cutting-edge AI-powered solutions that transform internal support experiences for enterprises.
  • Collaborate with a world-class team in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Shape the future of intelligent employee service management and drive meaningful impact by solving real organizational challenges at scale.
  • Be part of a culture of innovation, collaboration, personal growth and continuous learning.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

- Data-Driven Iteration: Leverage data-driven insights to continuously improve product offerings, tracking employee adoption, operational cost savings, and market share expansion.

What We’re Looking For



- Experience: 14+ years of product management experience in enterprise SaaS, with a demonstrated track record of taking an Agentic product from 0-to-1 and scaling it in a production environment.
- AI/ML Expertise: Hands-on familiarity with LLM orchestration (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex), embedding models, vector databases, and designing autonomous agent loops (planning, tool use, reflection). You deeply understand the trade-offs between different foundation models and fine-tuning vs. RAG approaches. Strong working knowledge of predictive ML models and data pipelines.
- Technical Fluency: Experience with AI evaluation techniques (e.g., LLM-as-a-judge) and continuous model improvement cycles based on human feedback. Ability to engage deeply with engineering and data science teams on architectural tradeoffs, model selection, and performance metrics.
- Strategic Execution: Proven track record of developing and executing comprehensive, multi-quarter product roadmaps that drive measurable business impact.
- Communication Skills: Exceptional executive presence with the ability to navigate stakeholder alignment and articulate complex AI concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
- Preferred Domain Knowledge: A proven ability to build scalable AI/LLM products is essential. Familiarity with Salesforce AI capabilities (e.g., Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, Data Cloud) and prior experience in IT Service Management (ITSM), HR Service Delivery, or Employee Workflows are highly preferred but not mandatory. 

Why Join Us?



- Work on cutting-edge AI-powered solutions that transform internal support experiences for enterprises.
- Collaborate with a world-class team in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
- Shape the future of intelligent employee service management and drive meaningful impact by solving real organizational challenges at scale.
- Be part of a culture of innovation, collaboration, personal growth and continuous learning.

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

title: Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
Role Summary:-

The Product Owner is responsible for managing complex business requirements, driving solution discussions, and ensuring successful delivery of product capabilities across domains and systems.

The role requires strong product thinking, insurance domain expertise, and the ability to operate effectively in AI-enabled delivery environments. The Product Owner is expected to leverage AI-assisted workflows to improve speed, quality, traceability, prioritization, and cross-functional collaboration.

The Product Owner is a member of the Product Management team of IDIT R&D, responsible for managing requirements for complex features in the system. The candidate should be able to run workshops with domain managers, Product Managers, and customers to elicit requirements, present solution designs, and take requirements through to implementation.

Pre-requisites

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering (CS/IT preferred) or equivalent qualification.
  • MBA preferred.

Experience

  • 6–9 years of relevant experience.
  • Should have some technical experience before transitioning to a BA/Product role.
  • Insurance or BFSI experience is a must.
  • Prior knowledge of Core Insurance is a must.
  • Experience of having worked in at least one implementation project.
  • Led end-to-end requirements for at least 2 modules.

Key Responsibilities

 Product & Requirement Ownership

  • Gather business requirements for medium to complex features and interfaces in the system (Contact/Policy, Claims/Accounting/Interfaces).
  • Document requirements in SDS.
  • Analyse and prioritize defects.
  • Conduct requirement discussions with Product Managers, Domain Managers, and customers.
  • Conduct walkthroughs of requirements with development and QA teams.
  • Attend daily stand-ups.
  • Conduct User Forums.
  • Conduct training sessions for junior members of the team.
  • Work as a core representative to project teams as needed.
  • Convert business requirements into Epics, Features, User Stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Drive end-to-end solution discussions across Product, Engineering, QA, Architecture, and Delivery teams.
  • Perform impact analysis across modules, systems, and business processes.
  • Prioritize backlog items aligned to business outcomes and roadmap objectives.
  • Ensure traceability from business requirements to implementation and validation.
  • Support product roadmap execution and release planning.

AI-Enabled Responsibilities

  • Use AI tools to accelerate requirement analysis, documentation, prioritization, and workshop preparation.
  • Use AI-assisted techniques for: story generation, acceptance criteria generation, process mapping, impact analysis, test scenario generation, SQL/query generation, knowledge retrieval, and defect analysis.
  • Validate AI-generated outputs for correctness, feasibility, traceability, hallucinations, and bias.
  • Use AI-enabled insights to improve delivery efficiency and decision-making.
  • Contribute reusable prompts, templates, and AI-assisted delivery assets.
  • Drive adoption of AI-enabled ways of working within teams.
  • Apply responsible AI practices including governance, explainability, privacy, and human oversight.

Mandatory Skills

  • Strong understanding of insurance processes and core insurance systems.
  • Experience in Product Ownership, Business Analysis, or Solution Design.
  • Ability to manage complex cross-functional requirements.
  • Strong stakeholder management and workshop facilitation skills.
  • Experience with Agile delivery methodologies.
  • Strong analytical and prioritization capabilities.
  • Working knowledge of APIs, integrations, and enterprise systems.
  • Excellent analytical skills and good design skills.
  • Intermediate SQL and data modelling skills (mandatory).
  • Understanding of SDLC and Agile concepts (mandatory).
  • Very good verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to document business requirements as user stories; break large epics into smaller features and stories and document them in SDS.
  • Ability to conduct demos and walkthroughs with POs and business users.
  • Techno-functional and business solutioning capability.
  • Ability to effectively leverage AI-enabled delivery tools.

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with AI-enabled delivery platforms and workflows.
  • Exposure to prompt engineering and AI-assisted analysis.
  • Exposure to digital transformation initiatives.
  • Exposure to Agentic AI concepts and orchestration-based workflows.

Key Characteristics

  • Outcome-oriented mindset.
  • Strong ownership and accountability.
  • Ability to balance speed with quality and governance.
  • Systems thinking and cross-domain understanding.
  • Coaching and mentoring mindset.

title: VP- Lead Product Owner- Issuer Services
descriptionHtml:
The Lead Product Owner is a hands-on position responsible for liaising between key Business / Product stakeholders across the firm and technology to exchange information in a concise and understandable way to promote development and delivery, operational stability, and quality process improvements, adhering to and implementing Agile principles on the assigned teams.

The individual will be an agile practitioner, with product and business knowledge with an attitude of continuous improvement. With experience of leading and managing people.

Lead Product owners will be responsible for managing the team, developing and executing the vision of how the product should function, define specific product features, and break those features into product backlog items and prioritize for the Scrum team to work on.

Works with Business Stakeholders and Product Managers to build the product vision, product roadmap and release Plan.

Responsibilities:

  • The Lead Product owner will be responsible for developing and executing the vision of how the product should function, define specific product features, and break those features into product backlog items and prioritize for the Scrum team to work on.
  • Managing the product owner team to support delivery, business prioritisation and focus.
  • Developing and explicitly communicating the Product Goal; Creating and clearly communicating Product Backlog Items; Ordering Product Backlog Items; Ensuring that the Product Backlog is transparent, visible, and understood.
  • Facilitate Agile development process, create and sustain high performing Agile teams, and help them deliver high quality software
  • Participate in all needed agile ceremonies including but not limited to sprint planning, refinements, sprint review, retros, and daily standups, scrum of scrums and monthly release deployment activities.
  • Work closely with Scrum Master and tech lead to ensure execution efficiency by through efficient sprint planning, maintaining optimal velocity, code quality and promotion of code into production
  • Work closely with the Business/Product Heads and Scrum Master/tech lead in the adoption of Agile software development practices (creating product roadmaps and backlogs tied to business value delivery, high quality user stories, release schedules and delivery planning, scrum meetings, velocity, and capacity planning)
  • Work closely with Scrum Master and tech lead to generate and monitor periodic reporting on team’s performance using Agile metrics - burndowns, Cumulative Flow Diagrams, Control Charts, sprint reports, test reports etc. to provide statistical proof of momentum and sustainability.
  • Familiarity with SAFe framework and Program Increment planning. Collaborate with RTE to conduct PI planning sessions with Agile team members and stakeholders to ensure alignment on objectives and priorities of upcoming PI.
  • Encourage Agile way of thinking for delivering business value for all team members and lead by example
  • Subject matter expert in confluence & JIRA including creation of swim lanes and dashboard, running JQL queries and customizing filters, JIRA report extraction and bulk uploads etc.
  • Influence a wide range of stakeholders (business, compliance, Legal, IT, etc.) to remove impediments and maximize team output.
  • Encourage an environment where an open communication and collaborative problem solving can pave the way for faster removal of any impediments, and where the impact of mistakes can be minimized through early detection, making them into learning opportunities.
  • Work closely with Scrum Master and tech lead to Identify, manage, and help mitigate issues and risks, with particular emphasis on timely removal of impediments for the team and/or directing obstacles to appropriate owners for quick resolution.
  • Work closely with Scrum Master and tech lead to facilitate discovering and enacting continuous improvement strategies to increase the productivity of the team and quality of deliverables including the Code Quality and app monitoring setup etc.
  • Compliance with Citibank policies and procedures for project delivery.
  • Partner with Agile coach and other agile teams to share findings, best practices, and resources to help mature the organizations agility.

Recommended Qualifications:

  • 3-5 years of experience within Product Owner and/or Product Management role and experience of the software development life cycle
  • Deep understanding of Agile methodology and frameworks (Kanban, Scrum, Lean, SAFe etc.)
  • Experience leading large scale enterprise transformation projects with global and cross functional teams in Agile environment
  • Excellent interpersonal communication and facilitation skills and proven ability to work with Global teams
  • Proficiency in JIRA, MS Office Tools with strong data analysis skills using MS Excel
  • Intellectual curiosity, analytical and conceptual thinker
  • Proactively seeks and develops new opportunities
  • Attention to detail and process/analytic mindset
  • Ability to build networks and relationships internally and externally
  • Ability to collaborate and clearly communicate with team members of an organization
  • Project Management skills with experience leading large cross functional initiatives

Education:

  • Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience

Nice to have:

  • Experience in Capital Markets, Securities Services / Issuer Services / investment management within financial industry is a plus

Certifications/Qualifications:

  • Certified Product Owner / Scrum Master (CSM), PMI-ACP (Agile Certified Practitioner), SAFe Scrum Master or similar certification
  • Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience
  • Master's degree preferred

This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.

The Team lead will report to the Global Head of Product Execution and Governance with a matrix to the India Cluster Head.

The individual will be an agile practitioner, with product and business knowledge with an attitude of continuous improvement. With experience of leading and managing people.

Lead Product owners will be responsible for managing the team, developing and executing the vision of how the product should function, define specific product features, and break those features into product backlog items and prioritize for the Scrum team to work on.

Works with Business Stakeholders and Product Managers to build the product vision, product roadmap and release Plan.

Responsibilities:



- The Lead Product owner will be responsible for developing and executing the vision of how the product should function, define specific product features, and break those features into product backlog items and prioritize for the Scrum team to work on.
- Managing the product owner team to support delivery, business prioritisation and focus.
- Developing and explicitly communicating the Product Goal; Creating and clearly communicating Product Backlog Items; Ordering Product Backlog Items; Ensuring that the Product Backlog is transparent, visible, and understood.
- Facilitate Agile development process, create and sustain high performing Agile teams, and help them deliver high quality software
- Participate in all needed agile ceremonies including but not limited to sprint planning, refinements, sprint review, retros, and daily standups, scrum of scrums and monthly release deployment activities.
- Work closely with Scrum Master and tech lead to ensure execution efficiency by through efficient sprint planning, maintaining optimal velocity, code quality and promotion of code into production
- Work closely with the Business/Product Heads and Scrum Master/tech lead in the adoption of Agile software development practices (creating product roadmaps and backlogs tied to business value delivery, high quality user stories, release schedules and delivery planning, scrum meetings, velocity, and capacity planning)
- Work closely with Scrum Master and tech lead to generate and monitor periodic reporting on team’s performance using Agile metrics - burndowns, Cumulative Flow Diagrams, Control Charts, sprint reports, test reports etc. to provide statistical proof of momentum and sustainability.
- Familiarity with SAFe framework and Program Increment planning. Collaborate with RTE to conduct PI planning sessions with Agile team members and stakeholders to ensure alignment on objectives and priorities of upcoming PI.
- Encourage Agile way of thinking for delivering business value for all team members and lead by example
- Subject matter expert in confluence & JIRA including creation of swim lanes and dashboard, running JQL queries and customizing filters, JIRA report extraction and bulk uploads etc.
- Influence a wide range of stakeholders (business, compliance, Legal, IT, etc.) to remove impediments and maximize team output.
- Encourage an environment where an open communication and collaborative problem solving can pave the way for faster removal of any impediments, and where the impact of mistakes can be minimized through early detection, making them into learning opportunities.
- Work closely with Scrum Master and tech lead to Identify, manage, and help mitigate issues and risks, with particular emphasis on timely removal of impediments for the team and/or directing obstacles to appropriate owners for quick resolution.
- Work closely with Scrum Master and tech lead to facilitate discovering and enacting continuous improvement strategies to increase the productivity of the team and quality of deliverables including the Code Quality and app monitoring setup etc.
- Compliance with Citibank policies and procedures for project delivery.
- Partner with Agile coach and other agile teams to share findings, best practices, and resources to help mature the organizations agility.

Recommended Qualifications:



- 3-5 years of experience within Product Owner and/or Product Management role and experience of the software development life cycle
- Deep understanding of Agile methodology and frameworks (Kanban, Scrum, Lean, SAFe etc.)
- Experience leading large scale enterprise transformation projects with global and cross functional teams in Agile environment
- Excellent interpersonal communication and facilitation skills and proven ability to work with Global teams
- Proficiency in JIRA, MS Office Tools with strong data analysis skills using MS Excel
- Intellectual curiosity, analytical and conceptual thinker
- Proactively seeks and develops new opportunities
- Attention to detail and process/analytic mindset
- Ability to build networks and relationships internally and externally
- Ability to collaborate and clearly communicate with team members of an organization
- Project Management skills with experience leading large cross functional initiatives

Education:



- Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience

Nice to have:



- Experience in Capital Markets, Securities Services / Issuer Services / investment management within financial industry is a plus

Certifications/Qualifications:



- Certified Product Owner / Scrum Master (CSM), PMI-ACP (Agile Certified Practitioner), SAFe Scrum Master or similar certification 
- Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience
- Master's degree preferred

This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.

The Team lead will report to the Global Head of Product Execution and Governance with a matrix to the India Cluster Head.

title: Product Owner - Fintech (Lending)
descriptionHtml:
About The Role

We are looking for a Product Owner to join our delivery team for a fintech client engagement in the consumer lending and payments space. You will work closely with the client and our engineering team to define, prioritise, and ship product across a mobile-first platform. This is a hands-on execution role suited for someone comfortable owning a backlog end-to-end in a fast-paced agile environment.

What you will do

  • Own and prioritise the product backlog — user stories, PRDs, and acceptance criteria
  • Run agile ceremonies — sprint planning, grooming, and retrospectives with the dev team
  • Act as the primary interface between the client and the internal delivery team
  • Define and track key product metrics — activation, engagement, and retention
  • Coordinate third-party integrations such as KYC, payment gateways, and APIs
  • Ensure product decisions align with compliance and regulatory requirements relevant to fintech

What we are looking for

  • 4–6 years in product management or product ownership, preferably in fintech, lending, or payments
  • Experience shipping mobile app products (Android/iOS) end to end
  • Solid understanding of consumer-facing financial products — credit, billing, repayment flows
  • Familiarity with Indian payment ecosystem — UPI, NACH, payment aggregators
  • Strong agile execution skills — backlog management, user story writing, sprint delivery
  • Proficiency with Figma or equivalent for wireframing and flow documentation
  • Clear, structured communicator — both written and verbal

Good to have

  • Exposure to BNPL or short-cycle credit products
  • Understanding of KYC/AML flows and digital onboarding
  • Working knowledge of SQL for pulling product metrics independently
  • Experience managing merchant-side or B2B product alongside a consumer app

title: Senior Director - Product Design
descriptionHtml:
About Freshworks

Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.

There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.

Freshworks Inc. builds uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional employee and customer experiences. Our people-first approach to AI eliminates friction, helping businesses reduce complexity, lower cost-to-serve, and deliver faster, more human support through enterprise-grade yet easy-to-use CX and IT solutions. Nearly 75,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks to power their Employee Experience (EX) and Customer Experience (CX) operations.

Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.



Job Description

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Vision & Strategy: Define and drive the long-term design vision and strategy for integrated product portfolios.

  • User advocacy: Champion a deep understanding of users to ensure products are not just functional, but indispensable.

  • Cross-functional alignment: Collaborate with senior leadership in Product Management and Engineering to create a cohesive product strategy that anticipates market trends and user needs.

  • Executive communication: Evangelize the power of design thinking to solve complex challenges, presenting strategies and concepts to executive stakeholders.

  • Team leadership: Lead, mentor, and expand a world-class product design team, fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.

  • Design execution: Oversee the entire design lifecycle:

    • Partner with our Research leader to drive foundational understanding of our user base.

    • Partner with our PM leaders to drive a design strategy that is focused on revenue growth, and long term retention

    • Drive design excellence with your product design team. Ensure deliverables are of high quality.

    • Evangelize the work - Regular updates to leadership, as needed.

  • Design systems: Partner with the Design systems leader to ensure the system serves the product needs, and stays up to date with the innovations being made in the product portfolio.

  • Data-informed process: Insist on a data-informed approach, leveraging user analytics and qualitative research to validate hypotheses and measure the impact of design solutions.

  • Supercharge team velocity: Transform the design team's operational efficiency by embedding AI into daily workflows, moving beyond personal productivity to fundamentally accelerate how quickly and effectively the team delivers enterprise-grade experiences.

Impact You Will Create

  • Drive business growth: Transform business software from a blocker into a tool that propels growth by creating better experiences for customers and employees.

  • Simplify complexity: Make the most complex processes simple, intelligent, and efficient.

  • Drive customer retention: You are customer obsessed. You advocate for a deep understanding of our customers, the ICP, and their unmet needs. This advocacy should directly tie to improved CSAT and overall better retention (NDRR).

  • Enhance productivity: Eliminate friction to make employees more effective and organizations more productive.

  • Deliver actionable insights: Tackle the immense challenge of visualizing complex relationships, streamlining critical workflows, and turning massive amounts of operational data into actionable insights.

Champion AI-Augmented design operations: Act as an early adopter and evangelist for integrating AI technologies into the end-to-end design lifecycle. Operationalize AI tools for rapid prototyping, generative asset creation, and automated research analysis to exponentially increase your team's output and elevate the quality of their strategic work.



Qualifications

  • Experience: 15 years in product design, with at least 5 years managing managers and senior ICs (Principal, Sr.Staff level).

  • Domain Expertise: Extensive experience designing complex, data-rich enterprise SaaS applications.

  • Portfolio: A compelling portfolio that showcases leadership and design work on products involving complex workflows, data visualization, and systems thinking.

  • Leadership Record: Proven ability to build, manage, and motivate high-performing design teams in a competitive technology landscape.

  • Technical Acumen: A strong aptitude for understanding highly technical domains and the ability to translate that complexity into simple, intuitive user experiences.

  • AI Adoption Record: Demonstrable experience integrating AI tools and methodologies into a design team's workflow at scale, with clear examples of how this adoption improved the overall velocity and quality of the team's deliverables.

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, or a related field.



Additional Information

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business. Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.

title: Director, Product Operations
descriptionHtml:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Director, Product Operations

Director, Product Operations, Interchange Governance

Overview

The Director, Network Products, will join a team driving the product strategy, roadmap, and execution of Mastercard’s global core payments network—one of the company’s most critical strategic assets, directly generating over $8B in revenue and enabling a broad portfolio of products and services.

The ideal candidate is a proven, forward thinking leader who collaborates effectively across business, pricing, and technology organizations. This role partners closely with Global and Regional Pricing and Engineering teams to deliver operationally ready, market leading solutions. Responsibilities include leading teams accountable for documentation, governance, and enablement to improve customer experience, speed to market, and operational excellence. The role’s objective is to deliver a globally standardized, transparent, and scalable interchange governance model while improving implementation quality, customer satisfaction, and enterprise alignment.

The Role

The Director of Interchange Governance provides strategic leadership and operational oversight for Mastercard’s global interchange capability. The role owns interchange governance, enablement, and execution, and is accountable for accelerating time to market, standardizing processes, and ensuring high quality, customer centric implementations across all regions.

  • Define and own the global Interchange operating model, including governance, decision frameworks, standardized processes, and global documentation across all regions and engineering.
  • Establish and lead a Single Door Entry governance model for all Interchange requests globally, ensuring transparency, prioritization, capacity management, and consistent decision-making.
  • Set the strategic direction for Interchange enablement, aligning enterprise objectives, growth priorities, regulatory requirements, and evolving customer needs.
  • Serve as the executive escalation point for complex, high-impact, or cross-regional Interchange initiatives.
  • Drive speed to market by reducing implementation timelines through process optimization, tooling improvements, and cross-functional alignment.
  • Lead an agile, scalable implementation model that balances speed, quality, and risk while enabling flexibility for regional market nuances.
  • Oversee global Interchange demand intake and solutioning, ensuring technical feasibility, alignment to governance, and consistency with global standards.
  • Partner with global and regional pricing, product, and technology teams to align roadmaps, readiness, and execution.
  • Champion customer-centric implementation and testing practices, increasing customer engagement, improving quality, and ensuring compliance with operational and regulatory standards.
  • Drive enterprise enablement and continuous improvement through training, implementation playbooks, stakeholder communications, KPIs, and data-driven performance insights.


About You

  • Brings deep expertise in the payments industry, including strong hands on knowledge of Interchange and GCMS, with a proven understanding of the Mastercard ecosystem and how technology delivery drives business outcomes.
  • Operates with a high degree of independence and accountability, demonstrating sound judgment and end to end ownership of program delivery.
  • Builds strong, trusted relationships across the organization and effectively influences stakeholders at all levels, including senior and executive leadership, while establishing credibility with cross functional teams.
  • Demonstrates strong people leadership by attracting, developing, and retaining top talent, and fostering an environment that promotes growth, accountability, and high performance.
  • Apply continuous improvement principles to enhance delivery frameworks, operational processes, and overall team efficiency.
  • Makes thoughtful, data driven decisions by assessing risks, managing trade offs, and resolving escalations in fast moving, complex environments.
  • Leverages emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence, to improve program management practices, increase operational efficiency, and support more informed decision making.
  • Exhibits a self starter mindset with a strong ability to learn quickly, work independently, thrive in fast paced environments, and adapt to shifting priorities while managing multiple responsibilities.
  • Possesses exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage, lead, and influence stakeholders across all levels of the organization, as well as internal and external partners.
  • Demonstrates strong visual storytelling capabilities, including data visualization and the creation of clear, compelling executive level presentations.
  • Brings strong project management capabilities, with demonstrated excellence in organization, planning, and task execution.
  • Is a highly collaborative partner, able to work effectively across functions to drive shared outcomes.


Corporate Security Responsibility

 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Product Owner - Core Banking
descriptionHtml:
Project Description:

Luxoft DXC Technology Company is an established company focusing on consulting and implementation of complex projects in the financial industry. At the interface between technology and business, we convince with our know-how, well-founded methodology and pleasure in success. As a reliable partner to our renowned customers, we support them in planning, designing and implementing the desired innovations. Together with the customer, we deliver top performance!

Responsibilities:

Feature Delivery & Ownership

- Own and deliver multiple features per quarter, with varying complexity across multiple teams

- Ensure smooth delivery across all lifecycle phases: Design, Development, IST, ET, VT, and Production Implementation

- Validate and ensure that delivery timelines are achievable across each phase

Backlog & Requirements Management

- Participate actively in L2 refinement sessions to understand feature scope and priorities

- Decompose features into detailed user stories in collaboration with L1 teams and technical leads

- Maintain a well-defined, healthy, and prioritized backlog, ensuring readiness for sprint execution

- Drive backlog grooming and refinement sessions

Planning & Prioritization

- Perform feature planning in collaboration with L1 teams and engineering leads

- Drive priority decisions in alignment with L2 stakeholders

- Ensure alignment between business priorities, technical feasibility, and delivery timelines

Agile Execution & Team Leadership

- Actively participate in and lead Agile ceremonies: Daily Stand-ups (DSUs), Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives

- Step into Scrum leadership responsibilities (in the absence of Scrum Masters)

- Ensure teams follow Agile best practices and deliver incrementally

Capacity & Delivery Management

- Manage and optimize capacity across three Agile teams

- Ensure efficient utilization of team bandwidth while balancing delivery commitments

- Monitor sprint progress and proactively address delivery bottlenecks

Risk & Dependency Management

- Identify, track, and manage RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) for all features

- Proactively escalate critical risks to L2 stakeholders when required

- Ensure dependencies across systems, teams, and integrations are effectively managed

Stakeholder Management & Collaboration

- Act as the primary interface between L2 stakeholders and L1 teams

- Foster strong collaboration through co-location and active engagement with teams

- Ensure transparent and timely communication of progress, risks, and decisions

Core Banking Domain Responsibilities

- Drive delivery across core banking modules such as CASA (Current & Savings Accounts), Lending / Loans, Payments & Settlements, Customer Lifecycle Management

- Ensure high levels of transaction accuracy, data integrity, and system reliability

- Support integration with downstream and upstream banking systems

Regulatory & Compliance Responsibilities

- Ensure all features comply with banking regulations and guidelines (e.g., RBI, KYC, AML)

- Embed compliance, audit, and security requirements into product features and user stories

- Work closely with Risk, Compliance, and Audit teams

- Support regulatory audits, production readiness reviews, compliance reporting, and documentation

- Ensure adherence to data privacy and protection standards and transaction monitoring requirements

Mandatory Skills Description:

Overall 10+ years of experience in IT and Banking

- Proven hands-on experience (4+ years) as a Product Owner/ Business Analyst in Core Banking domain and working in an Agile product development environment, with demonstrated backlog ownership and delivery execution

- Strong knowledge of core banking platforms (e.g., Hogan, Finacle, T24, Flexcube)

- Deep understanding of Deposits (CASA) and different deposit products and their lifecycle (DDA, TDA/CDAs, etc.), Loans/Lending, Payments

- Good experience with backlog management tools (JIRA, DevOps, etc)

- Strong experience gathering requirements from stakeholders and end users and converting them into clear, testable user stories with acceptance criteria.

- Solid understanding of Agile frameworks (Scrum and/or Kanban) and active participation in Agile ceremonies

- Hands-on experience using Jira, Confluence, or similar tools for backlog management, documentation, and delivery tracking

- Ability to analyze business and data insights to drive prioritization and decision-making; SQL or reporting experience strongly preferred.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and technology teams and across time zones



Key Competencie

s- Core Banking Domain Expertis

e- Backlog Management & Story Decompositio

n- Agile Delivery & Sprint Executio

n- Capacity Planning & Multi-team Coordinatio

n- Stakeholder Management and Communicatio

n- Regulatory & Compliance Awarenes

s- Risk & Dependency Managemen

t- Analytical Thinking & Decision Makin

gNice-to-Have Skills Description

:Preferred Qualifications

.-Knowledge of automation tools for mainframe systems

Project Description:
Luxoft DXC Technology Company is an established company focusing on consulting and implementation of complex projects in the financial industry. At the interface between technology and business, we convince with our know-how, well-founded methodology and pleasure in success. As a reliable partner to our renowned customers, we support them in planning, designing and implementing the desired innovations. Together with the customer, we deliver top performance!
Responsibilities:
Feature Delivery & Ownership
- Own and deliver multiple features per quarter, with varying complexity across multiple teams
- Ensure smooth delivery across all lifecycle phases: Design, Development, IST, ET, VT, and Production Implementation
- Validate and ensure that delivery timelines are achievable across each phase
Backlog & Requirements Management
- Participate actively in L2 refinement sessions to understand feature scope and priorities
- Decompose features into detailed user stories in collaboration with L1 teams and technical leads
- Maintain a well-defined, healthy, and prioritized backlog, ensuring readiness for sprint execution
- Drive backlog grooming and refinement sessions
Planning & Prioritization
- Perform feature planning in collaboration with L1 teams and engineering leads
- Drive priority decisions in alignment with L2 stakeholders
- Ensure alignment between business priorities, technical feasibility, and delivery timelines
Agile Execution & Team Leadership
- Actively participate in and lead Agile ceremonies: Daily Stand-ups (DSUs), Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives
- Step into Scrum leadership responsibilities (in the absence of Scrum Masters)
- Ensure teams follow Agile best practices and deliver incrementally
Capacity & Delivery Management
- Manage and optimize capacity across three Agile teams
- Ensure efficient utilization of team bandwidth while balancing delivery commitments
- Monitor sprint progress and proactively address delivery bottlenecks
Risk & Dependency Management
- Identify, track, and manage RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) for all features
- Proactively escalate critical risks to L2 stakeholders when required
- Ensure dependencies across systems, teams, and integrations are effectively managed
Stakeholder Management & Collaboration
- Act as the primary interface between L2 stakeholders and L1 teams
- Foster strong collaboration through co-location and active engagement with teams
- Ensure transparent and timely communication of progress, risks, and decisions
Core Banking Domain Responsibilities
- Drive delivery across core banking modules such as CASA (Current & Savings Accounts), Lending / Loans, Payments & Settlements, Customer Lifecycle Management
- Ensure high levels of transaction accuracy, data integrity, and system reliability
- Support integration with downstream and upstream banking systems
Regulatory & Compliance Responsibilities
- Ensure all features comply with banking regulations and guidelines (e.g., RBI, KYC, AML)
- Embed compliance, audit, and security requirements into product features and user stories
- Work closely with Risk, Compliance, and Audit teams
- Support regulatory audits, production readiness reviews, compliance reporting, and documentation
- Ensure adherence to data privacy and protection standards and transaction monitoring requirements

- Deep understanding of Deposits (CASA) and different deposit products and their lifecycle (DDA, TDA/CDAs, etc.), Loans/Lending, Payments

- Hands-on experience using Jira, Confluence, or similar tools for backlog management, documentation, and delivery tracking
