title: Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
Join our India Tech Hub – Be among the first hires!

Kobie, a 35-year veteran of the loyalty industry, a multi-year Forrester Leader, and USA Top Workplace is expanding its global footprint by establishing a Tech Hub in India. Kobie partners with global brands to build deep connections with their customers through personalized, data-driven loyalty experiences and has a mission of growing enterprise value through loyalty. The Tech Hub will serve as a Global Capabilities Center for a broad range of technology roles, and this is your chance to play a pivotal role in shaping our presence in India. Join us as we continue to lead in loyalty, delivering innovative customer experiences for some of the world’s most recognized brands while working alongside some of the best and brightest in loyalty.

The Product Owner team makes Kobie's strategic product vision a reality through the development of technology solutions. We drive projects forward, collaborating with development teams and stakeholders to deliver unparalleled personalized experiences to customers worldwide. We are quick on our feet, using critical thinking and creative problem solving to optimize the value of products released. We champion platform standards to achieve long-lasting, quality outcomes that help our clients grow enterprise value through loyalty.

How You Will Make An Impact

  • Lead design and execution of roadmap enhancementsto Kobie Alchemy® Loyalty Cloud's loyalty decisioning (Experience Engine) and experience delivery (Producer) technology product suites.
  • Gather requirements across clients and industry verticals to identify scope and maximize reusability of new feature requests.
  • Manage the product backlogincluding dependencies, priority, sequence, strategy, and business objectives.
  • Identify and address challenges that arise during the product development lifecycle, collaborating with team members to find creative solutions and keep development on track.
  • Provide mechanisms for teams and stakeholders to view and track team and product work progress across releases and major product milestones.
  • Share vision and purpose for all product development efforts, gaininginterest and buy-in from various audiences, including business and technical roles at multiple levels of the organization.
  • Be a steward for excellence in your domain of expertise, advocating for and evolving platform standards while building the team's shared understanding.

What You Need To Be Successful

  • 7+ years working in a Product Owner, Business Systems Analyst, Product Manager, or similar role
  • Demonstrated experience driving Agile/Scrum delivery projects that involve web-based software development and 3rd party integrations via API and batch
  • Strong technical background, with a knack for translating concepts into language business and tech roles can understand
  • Dot connector, ability to identify patterns and navigate complex challenges
  • Loyalty product, program, or industry experience a plus
  • Familiarity with UX research and best practices a plus
  • PMI-PBA/CBAP/CSPO/PSPO certification a plus 
  • Bachelor's degree

About Kobie

Named a Top Workplace in the USA and Top Remote Workplace, Kobie is where the best minds in loyalty come together, driven by passion and innovation. We’re always looking for talented individuals ready to join a collaborative, growth-focused culture.

As a trusted partner to some of the world’s most recognized brands, we are loyalty leaders, helping brands build lasting emotional connections with their consumers.  We do this with a strategy-led technology approach that uncovers the truth behind what drives consumers on an emotional level.As we launch our India Tech Hub, we are excited to bring our award-winning culture to a new region - creating an environment where collaboration, flexibility, and career growth come together to build something truly special.

We are proud to be the only loyalty provider to be externally recognized for their culture. We believe people thrive when they feel valued, supported, and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion ensures every teammate has a voice and the opportunity to be heard.

Giving back is in our DNA at Kobie,through an annual fundraiser, charitable partnerships, and volunteer opportunities, we encourage our teammates to make a difference in their communities.

To support our teammates beyond just their careers, we offer highly competitive benefits, comprehensive health coverage, and well-being perks that support our teammates and their dependents. We understand the importance of time for life outside of work - recognizing public holidays,offering flexible time off, and prioritizing work-life balance.

As we expand into India, our new teammates will be fully integrated with our U.S. teams, working on global projects and gaining exposure to top industry leaders. With continued growth, we will establish a physical office in Bengaluru, India, giving teammates aspace for collaboration and fostering connection.

Now is the perfect time to join Kobie. Be part of something big and help shape the future of our global capabilities center, the Kobie India Tech Hub.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Director of Product
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Entain India is the engineering and delivery powerhouse for Entain, one of the world’s leading global sports and gaming groups. Established in Hyderabad in 2001, we’ve grown from a small tech hub into a dynamic force, delivering cutting-edge software solutions and support services that power billions of transactions for millions of users worldwide.

Our focus on quality at scale drives us to create innovative technology that supports Entain’s mission to lead the change in global sports and gaming sector. At Entain India, we make the impossible possible, together.


As Director of Product, you will be responsible for driving the vision, strategy, and execution of our product portfolio to deliver exceptional Core Platform & CRM products & services whilst achieving our business goals. You would develop and lead a world class team of product leaders across our locations and be responsible for your platform pillar experience within the Entain group for all our markets and all our brands.

In your role you are part of the Senior Product Leadership Team and will also be working with Entain’s Global Leadership, reporting to the CTO you will be part of the Platform Team.

Are you ready to launch a winning career?


What will you do:

  • You will develop and articulate a compelling and inspiring Core Platform and CRM product vision and strategy that delights our upstream services and customers. You will live and breathe the data and insights about your products, constantly seeking points of leverage that will help us achieve Entain’s broader goals and ambitions.
  • You will champion our transformation of the Platform by partnering with the Platform Engineering Director to modernise the Core Platform and CRM (reward) components which underpin all our businesses.
  • You will design a model for the core Player Account Management (PAM) services as a Platform-as-a-Service, enabling flexible integration and loose coupling.
  • You will use a techno-functional approach to design backend systems that support multiple micro frontend labels effectively.
  • You will develop, lead and coach a stellar team of product managers, guiding them in discovery, prioritization, and execution of product initiatives. title: Product Owner/ Business Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Project Role: Product Owner/ Business Analyst

Work Experience: 2-10 Years

Work location: Chennai OR Bangalore

Work Mode: Hybrid

Must Have Skills: EMR/EHR in Hospital domain


Job Overview

A Hospital Information System (HIS) Product Owner is responsible for defining, prioritizing, and managing the product backlog for assigned modules within the HIS, ensuring the product meets business needs and delivers value to users. This role involves close collaboration with stakeholders across various teams including product engineering, QA and Client service teams as well as Client users to translate business requirements into actionable user stories and acceptance criteria. They also play a crucial role in analyzing the product backlog and roadmap, guiding the development process from concept to launch


Key Responsibilities

  • Product Vision and Strategy
  • Understanding product vision, goals, and strategy for the HIS, ensuring alignment with business objectives and user need
  • Requirements Gathering and Management
  • Working with stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document requirements, translating them into detailed user stories and acceptance criteria
  • Backlog Management
  • Prioritizing and managing the product backlog, ensuring that features and enhancements are aligned with the product vision and roadmap
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Collaborating with various stakeholders, including clinicians, administrators, and IT teams, to gather feedback, manage expectations, and ensure alignment
  • Agile Development
  • Participating in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and other Agile ceremonies to guide development efforts and ensure timely delivery.
  • Quality Assurance
  • Collaborating with the QA team to ensure the delivered product meets quality standards and user expectations.
  • Market Research
  • Staying informed about industry trends, competitor offerings, and emerging technologies to identify opportunities for innovation and improvement.


User Experience:

  • Working with UX/UI designers to ensure the HIS is user-friendly and provides a positive user experience
  • Regulatory Compliance
  • Ensuring the HIS complies with relevant healthcare regulations and standards
  • Performance Monitoring
  • Tracking key product metrics to assess performance and identify areas for improvement
  • Training and Support
  • Working with training teams to develop and deliver training materials for users


Skills and Experience

  • Healthcare Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of the healthcare industry, including workflows, regulations, and technology
  • Product Management Experience: Proven experience in product management, preferably with HIS or other healthcare IT system
  • Agile Methodology: Familiarity with Agile development methodologies, such as Scrum or Kanban.
  • Communication and Collaboration: Excellent communication, interpersonal, and collaboration skills.
  • Problem-Solving: Ability to identify and resolve complex problems.
  • Technical Proficiency: Understanding of software development principles and technologies.
  • Leadership and Influence: Ability to lead and motivate cross-functional teams.
  • Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions

title: Bogie Product Director
descriptionHtml:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

Could you be the full-time Bogie Product Director in Bangalore we’re looking for?

Your future role

Take on a new challenge and apply your strategic vision and leadership expertise in a new cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside dynamic and collaborative teammates.

You'll play a pivotal role in driving innovation, ensuring the development and delivery of high-performing, cost-effective, and competitive bogie products that align with Alstom's mission for smarter and greener mobility. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (engineering, industrial, procurement, tender and costing), lead product roadmaps, and ensure the successful execution of programs, and much more.

You’ll specifically take care of coordinating product strategies and roadmaps, as well as ensuring product readiness for tenders and projects, but also fostering collaboration across teams to achieve quality, cost, and delivery targets.

We’ll look to you for:

  • Representing the RSC Platform on-site and ensuring innovation, development, tendering, launch, and sustainability for assigned technologies and products
  • Overseeing product portfolio management and ensuring alignment with the RS platform
  • Leading product roadmap activities, including development, procurement, and industrial strategy
  • Delivering QCD (Quality, Cost, Delivery) targets for programs
  • Managing product validation and homologation processes to meet market regulations
  • Driving product competitiveness through continuous improvement and Return of Experience (REX)

All About You

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

  • Master’s degree in a technical or equivalent field
  • 10+ years of experience in product management
  • Knowledge of product business and industrial environments
  • Experience in transversal and/or international leadership roles
  • Fluency in both English and French
  • Strategic vision and ability to benchmark competition
  • Strong management and organizational skills within a matrix environment
  • Excellent communication skills and team-oriented mindset
  • Proactive problem-solving and decision-making abilities
  • Knowledge of the railway industry

Things you’ll enjoy Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:

  • Enjoy stability, challenges and a long-term career free from boring daily routines
  • Work with new security standards for rail signalling
  • Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
  • Contribute to innovative projects
  • Utilise our inclusive and flexible working environment
  • Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
  • Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning
  • Progress towards senior leadership opportunities
  • Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

Important to note

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

title: VP - Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
hackajob is collaborating with Barclays to connect them with exceptional professionals for this role.

Embark on a transformative journey as a VP - Product Owner, where you'll have to support change delivery managers in the delivery of successful projects, while ensuring that project management processes and practices are aligned with controls and governance standards and that projects are aligned with the organisation's strategic objectives.

Key Critical Skills Required For This Role Include

  • Candidate must be experienced as an agile Product Owner or Lead Product Owner.
  • Experience with Banks & Financial Institutions ideally with digital/ challenger banks will be added advantage.
  • Strong data focus and experience (candidate will be leading a Data Product delivery).
  • Candidate can be a technical product owner with strong tech & data background.

You may be assessed on key essential skills relevant to succeed in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role is based out of Pune.

Purpose of the role

To support change delivery managers in the delivery of successful projects, while ensuring that project management processes and practices are aligned with controls and governance standards and that projects are aligned with the organisation's strategic objectives.

Accountabilities

  • Support to change delivery managers, ensuring their programme is compliant with the Barclays Control Framework, including oversight of controls and governance standards.
  • Creation and implementation of standardised PMO processes and methodologies that are aligned with controls and governance standards and that support the delivery of successful projects.  .
  • Monitoring of project performance, including tracking of project progress, identification of risks assumptions, issues and dependencies, and creation of report on project status to senior management.
  • Support of project documentation, including maintenance of project plans, schedules, and budgets, and ensuring that project documentation is up-to-date and accurate.
  • Facilitation of project governance, including ensuring that projects are aligned with the organisation's strategic objectives, and that project risks assumptions, issues and dependencies are managed effectively.
  • Provision of change management framework training to project managers and other stakeholders, ensuring that they have the necessary skills and knowledge to deliver successful projects.  .
  • Continuous improvement of project management practices, including identification of areas for improvement and implementation of changes to improve project delivery.

Vice President Expectations

  • To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
  • If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
  • If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
  • OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
  • Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
  • Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
  • Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
  • Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
  • Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
  • Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
  • Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
  • Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
Product Owner - IT - Digital Products & CX.

Work Location: Dubai

As an Product Owner, you will help manage and improve a real estate mobile app from end to end. Working closely with the Product Manager, your role is to turn business needs and user requirements into practical product features that deliver a smooth and engaging experience.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Product Execution:
  • Break down business requirements into user stories, manage the backlog, and ensure features are delivered correctly and meet expectations.
  • Team Collaboration:
  • Work daily with developers, designers, and stakeholders in an Agile setup—participating in sprints, clarifying requirements, and keeping everyone aligned.
  • UX & Quality Focus:
  • Review app designs and live features to ensure they are user-friendly, consistent, and meet high usability standards.
  • Content Management:
  • Oversee all in-app content (like property details, banners, messaging) to ensure it is accurate, well-structured, and aligned with branding.
  • Analytics & Improvement:
  • Track user behavior and app performance (engagement, conversions, drop-offs) and use insights to suggest improvements and optimizations.
  • Domain Understanding:
  • Build knowledge of real estate workflows (buyers, renters, agents) and help enhance features like search, listings, and lead management.

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong experience in product ownership / business analysis (5–7+ years)
  • Hands-on with Agile/Scrum methodologies
  • Skilled in user story writing and requirement definition
  • Good understanding of UX principles and customer-first thinking
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills
  • Experience with mobile apps and analytics tools is a plus

Découvrez votre prochaine opportunité au sein d'une organisation qui compte parmi les 500 plus importantes entreprises mondiales. Envisagez des opportunités innovantes, découvrez notre culture enrichissante et travaillez avec des équipes talentueuses qui vous poussent à vous développer chaque jour. Nous savons ce qu’il faut faire pour diriger UPS vers l'avenir : des personnes passionnées dotées d’une combinaison unique de compétences. Si vous avez les qualités, de la motivation, de l'autonomie ou le leadership pour diriger des équipes, il existe des postes adaptés à vos aspirations et à vos compétences d'aujourd'hui et de demain.

Fiche De Poste

The Lead Business Systems Analyst functionally leads a team of Business Systems Analysts who develop business and functional work products to support new projects and existing applications for the organization. He/She plans Business Systems Analysis (BSA) teamwork, allocates resources to projects, and reviews work products to ensure quality and adherence to organizational standards. This position guides project teams to achieve quality deliverables. He/She mediates conflicts to ensure successful team dynamics and to mitigate risks (e.g., project’s progress, successful completion, etc.). This position provides leadership in the development of BSA work products, standards, process improvements, and defect resolution. He/She leads Information Services (I.S.) projects to ensure the completion of deliverables for small projects or components of larger projects. The Lead Business Systems Analyst determines the impact and integration of solutions to business processes and systems. He/She serves as a liaison between the business community and I.S. This position researches industry best practices, standards, trends, tools, methodologies, emerging technologies, and techniques. The Lead Business Systems Analyst collaborates with stakeholders and senior management to establish and implement processes that enhance efficiency and improve work products for the enterprise. This position assists junior team members with project related activities and tasks.

Type De Contrat

en CDI

Chez UPS, égalité des chances, traitement équitable et environnement de travail inclusif sont des valeurs clefs auxquelles nous sommes attachés.

title: Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
About Persistent

We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654.4M FY26 revenue with 17.4% Y-o-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3.2% Q-o-Q and 16.2% Y-o-Y growth. Our 27,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2026.

About Position

We are hiring a Product Owner with strong Lending (LOS) domain expertise to drive product vision, prioritize features, and lead Agile delivery. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into impactful solutions, ensuring seamless product execution and enhanced customer experience in a fast-paced fintech environment. Please mention a brief description of the position.

  • Role: Product Owner
  • Location: Any PSL Location
  • Experience: 6 to 10 Years
  • Job Type: Full Time Employment

What You'll Do

  • Assess business value, develop business cases, and prioritize epics, stories, and themes aligned with product vision and strategic goals.
  • Define and manage product deliveries, release plans, and feature scope in collaboration with platform leadership.
  • Draft product objectives and strategies, leveraging data-driven insights for decision-making.
  • Define and track KPIs; utilize analytics, A/B testing, and user feedback to refine product features.
  • Convert functional specifications into actionable user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
  • Own, maintain, and refine the product backlog; lead backlog grooming and sprint planning sessions.
  • Manage release planning and track progress through development and QA phases in collaboration with the Scrum Master.
  • Lead software gate reviews, including formal and informal handoffs.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders on product visioning and concept development.
  • Translate complex sprint outcomes and technical updates into business-friendly summaries.
  • Act as the voice of the customer across engineering, UX, QA, and business teams.
  • Proactively identify and escalate risks and impediments to program leadership.
  • Ensure understanding of end-to-end customer experience, integrations, and technical dependencies.
  • Drive continuous improvement in product development practices.
  • Thrive in a collaborative, team-oriented culture with shared accountability.

Expertise You'll Bring

  • Experience working as a Product Owner or in a similar role within software product development.
  • Strong domain knowledge in Lending (LOS mandatory) and familiarity with LMS systems.
  • Solid understanding of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban); SAFe experience is a plus.
  • Proven ability to write clear user stories and translate business requirements into technical specifications.
  • Hands-on experience collaborating with engineering, QA, UX, and cross-functional teams.
  • Product Owner certification preferred; Scrum Master certification is an added advantage.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
  • Advanced English communication skills (B2+ or higher).
  • Prior experience in FinTech is a plus.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
  • Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
  • Annual health check-ups
  • Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  • We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
  • Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
  • If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment

Let’s unleash your full potential at Persistent - persistent.com/careers

“Persistent is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind.”

title: Product Owner – Global Fraud Solutions (India)
descriptionHtml:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

What We'll Bring

We are seeking a Product Owner to join TransUnion’s Global Fraud Solutions team and play a hands-on role in delivering high-quality, customer-focused capabilities across our Core Fraud Solutions.

As a Product Owner, your primary focus will be translating product and business needs into well-defined user stories, supporting development teams through execution, and ensuring delivered functionality meets business expectations. You’ll work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, QA, and business stakeholders, owning day-to-day backlog execution and UAT readiness rather than high-level feature or epic ownership.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working close to delivery, thrives in Agile environments, and takes pride in the quality and completeness of what gets released.

This position is based in India, with limited travel.

What You'll Bring

What You’ll Do

  • Work closely with Product Managers to understand product vision and roadmap, and translate them into clear, actionable user stories for development teams.
  • Own the day-to-day product backlog execution, including writing user stories, defining acceptance criteria, refining requirements, and supporting backlog grooming sessions.
  • Break down requirements into executable stories that can be delivered within a sprint, ensuring clarity for engineering and QA teams.
  • Create lightweight wireframes, user flows, or mockups to clearly communicate user experience and functional expectations.
  • Actively support Agile scrum teams by answering questions, clarifying requirements, and making quick trade-off decisions during development.
  • Plan, coordinate, and participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by defining test scenarios, validating solutions, and ensuring readiness for release.
  • Partner with QA, Engineering, and stakeholders to ensure defects, enhancements, and refinements are properly understood and prioritized.
  • Work effectively in a matrixed, global environment with multiple development teams and stakeholders.
  • Use modern tools, including AI-enabled tools, to improve productivity in story writing, analysis, documentation, testing support, and overall delivery efficiency.

Impact You'll Make

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or in a similar delivery-focused product role within B2B software or services.
  • Strong hands-on experience writing user stories, defining acceptance criteria, and supporting sprint execution.
  • Proven experience working in Agile/Scrum teams and supporting multiple sprint teams simultaneously.
  • Solid experience with UAT execution, including test planning, validation, and stakeholder sign-off.
  • Ability to create wireframes, mockups, or user flows to support requirement clarity and user experience discussions.
  • Familiarity with identity fraud, risk management, authentication, or financial services platforms is highly desirable.
  • Good understanding of application architecture, APIs, databases, and system integrations, enabling effective collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Comfort using AI-powered tools to enhance analysis, documentation, testing workflows, or delivery outcomes (hands-on experience is a plus; curiosity and openness are essential).
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across diverse teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, Engineering, or a related field. MBA preferred

This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.

title: Product Owner, Technical
descriptionHtml:
Description

About Norstella:

Norstella is a premier and critical global life sciences data and AI solutions provider dedicated to improving patient access to life-saving therapies. Norstella supports pharmaceutical and biotech companies across the full drug development lifecycle — from pipeline to patient. Our mission is simple: to help our clients bring therapies to market faster and more efficiently, ultimately impacting patient lives.

Norstella unites market-leading brands - Citeline, Evaluate, MMIT, Panalgo, Skipta and The Dedham Group and delivers must-have answers and insights, leveraging AI, for critical strategic, clinical, and commercial decision-making. We help our clients: 

  • Accelerate the drug development cycle 
  • Assess competition and bring the right drugs to market 
  • Make data driven commercial and financial decisions
  • Match and recruit patients for clinical trials
  • Identify and address barriers to therapies


Norstella serves most pharmaceutical and biotech companies around the world, along with regulators like the FDA, and payers. By providing critical proprietary data supporting AI-driven workflows, Norstella helps clients make decisions faster and with greater confidence. Norstella’s investments in AI are transforming how data is consumed and decisions are made, disrupting inefficient legacy workflows and helping the industry become more efficient, innovative, and responsive to patient needs.

Job Description

  • Norstella is seeking a skilled and dynamic Technical Product Owner with a background in Market Access to join our team.
  • As a Technical Product Owner, you will play a crucial role in driving the development and success of our innovative internal platforms and solutions.
  • You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, stakeholders to ensure the successful delivery of these solutions.
  • MMIT, a Norstella company, is focused on solving the “what and why” of market access, and has been a trusted, go-to-market partner to more than 1,300 biopharma and payer customers for nearly three decades. MMIT believes that patients who need life-saving treatments should not face delays because accessing drugs can be confusing. MMIT’s expert teams of clinicians, data specialists and market researchers provide clarity and confidence so that our clients can make better decisions. 


Responsibilities

  • Manage the product backlog and prioritize features based on business value, customer needs, and market trends.
  • Define, refine, and communicate product vision, goals, and user stories to the development team and stakeholders.
  • Collaborate closely with the development team to translate requirements into actionable tasks and ensure timely delivery of high-quality products.
  • Work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, address concerns, and ensure alignment on product strategy and roadmap.
  • Facilitate agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for platform-related questions, issues, and updates from stakeholders.
  • Maintain a deep understanding of the market, industry regulations, and market access challenges to inform decision-making.
  • Collaborate with the UX/UI design team to create intuitive and user-friendly product interfaces.
  • Ensure effective communication and collaboration across all levels of the organization, including technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a Technical Product Owner or similar role, preferably in the healthcare or pharmaceutical industry.
  • Proven experience in managing product backlogs, defining user stories, and prioritizing features.
  • Strong understanding of agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, etc.) and ability to apply agile principles in a fast-paced development environment.
  • Hands-on experience using standard database management systems (Relational/NoSQL) for self-discovery of data and problem solving.
  • Experience integrating data between systems; including knowledge of data mapping, transformation rules and managing data quality
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills and ability to make data-driven decisions.
  • Proficient in using project management and collaboration tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence, Trello) to manage product development processes.
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, such as Business Administration, Marketing, or a related discipline.


Preferred

  • Background in Market Access within the healthcare or pharmaceutical industry.
  • Previous software development experience 
  • Experience using Data Science to solve business problems 
  • Experience working with diverse stakeholders, including healthcare providers, payers, and regulatory bodies.


At Norstella, we value innovation, collaboration, and a passion for making a positive impact in the healthcare industry. If you are a motivated and results-oriented Product Owner with a background in Market Access, we invite you to join our talented team and contribute to our mission of improving patient access to quality healthcare solutions.

Our Guiding Principles for success at Norstella

01: Bold, Passionate, Mission-First 

02: Integrity, Truth, Reality

03: Kindness, Empathy, Grace

04: Resilience, Mettle, Perseverance

05: Humility, Gratitude, Learning

Benefits

  • Health Insurance
  • Provident Fund
  • Reimbursement of Certification Expenses
  • Gratuity
  • 24x7 Health Desk


Norstella is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate on the grounds of gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, gender reassignment, race, color, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, disability or age. Our ethos is to respect and value people’s differences, to help everyone achieve more at work as well as in their personal lives so that they feel proud of the part they play in our success. We believe that all decisions about people at work should be based on the individual’s abilities, skills, performance and behavior and our business requirements. Norstella operates a zero tolerance policy to any form of discrimination, abuse or harassment.

Sometimes the best opportunities are hidden by self-doubt. We disqualify ourselves before we have the opportunity to be considered. Regardless of where you came from, how you identify, or the path that led you here- you are welcome. If you read this job description and feel passion and excitement, we’re just as excited about you.

All legitimate roles with Norstella will be posted on Norstella’s job board which is located at norstella.com/careers. If a role is not posted on this job board, a candidate should assume the role is not a legitimate role with Norstella. Norstella is not responsible for an application that may be submitted by or through a third-party and candidates should proceed with extreme caution if a third-party approaches them about an open role with Norstella. Norstella will never ask for anything of value or any type of payment during or as part of any recruitment, interview, or pre-hire onboarding process. If you are aware of or have reason to believe a job posting purportedly for a role with Norstella is fraudulent or otherwise not authorized by Norstella, please contact the Company using the following email address: ApplicationHelp@norstella.com.

title: Director Global Product Management & Upstream Marketing
descriptionHtml:
At Fresenius Medical Care, we are the global leader in kidney care, committed to improving the lives of patients with chronic kidney disease. Our mission is to deliver high-quality, innovative products, services, and care across the entire healthcare journey. Guided by our vision—“Creating a future worth living. For patients. Worldwide. Every day.”—we work with purpose and compassion, supported by a global team of over 110.000 employees.

Within our Care Enablement segment, we develop and provide life-sustaining medical products, digital health solutions, and therapies that empower clinical teams and improve patient outcomes. Our FME Reignite strategy drives transformation through innovation, efficiency, and sustainable growth.

Our values guide how we work:


  • We Care for our patients, each other, and our communities
  • We Connect across teams and borders to deliver excellence together
  • We Commit to doing things the right way— growing with purpose and leading kidney care with integrity and innovation


In-Center as one of three therapy verticals focuses on delivering high-quality, clinic-based hemodialysis to patients worldwide. Its mission is to support healthcare providers in offering safe, consistent, and patient-centered care in dialysis clinics.

The team collaborates across Product Design, Clinical Protocols, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, and Commercial functions to equip clinics with effective, innovative solutions that meet high standards and improve patient outcomes. Join our passionate team and help shape healthcare worldwide!

The Director, Product Management & Upstream Marketing is responsible for defining and driving the global portfolio strategy and lifecycle management, with a strong focus on profitability, competitiveness, and sustainability. The role leads the entry and value‑segment strategy and ensures portfolio alignment with overall business objectives, particularly in highly price‑sensitive and tender‑driven markets. Join our passionate team and help shape healthcare worldwide!

Your Responsibilities:


  • Define and drive the global portfolio strategy, including lifecycle management, optimization, and rationalization
  • Lead the entry and value‑segment strategy to ensure strong competitiveness in price‑sensitive markets
  • Manage portfolio trade‑offs to balance growth, profitability, and complexity
  • Identify and drive initiatives to improve cost, margin, and portfolio efficiency
  • Align closely with value streams and senior leadership on portfolio priorities and decisions
  • Partner with regional and country teams on pricing, tenders, and market‑specific portfolio strategies
  • Develop a deep understanding of competitive dynamics and define response strategies against low‑cost competitors
  • Support countries in the preparation and execution of requests for proposals (RFPs)
  • Provide structured product and portfolio training in collaboration with HQ functions
  • Build strong working relationships with global sales, marketing, and cross‑functional teams
  • Engage senior leadership with clear updates on portfolio performance, risks, and strategic initiatives
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal SOPs


Your Profile:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Life Sciences, or equivalent; MBA or advanced degree in Marketing, Strategy, or General Management
  • 15+ years of experience in product management within the medical device or healthcare industry
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Demonstrated experience managing global portfolios across the full product lifecycle
  • Proven leadership and collaboration skills across cross‑functional and global teams, including the ability to lead and influence within complex matrix organizations without direct authority, with a self‑motivated, results‑oriented approach and comfort operating in dynamic and changing environments
  • Deep market and therapy‑area knowledge, ideally in dialysis or renal care
  • Strong expertise in upstream marketing, portfolio strategy, and lifecycle management
  • Medical‑technical knowledge of hemodialysis products and therapies
  • Experience or familiarity with digital marketing, marketing automation, and project management tools


Our Offer for you:

There is a lot you can discover at Fresenius Medical Care, regardless in which field you are an expert and how much experience you have - all dedicated to your professional journey.


  • Whether in front of or behind the scenes - you are helping to make ever better medicine available to more and more people around the world
  • Individual opportunities for self-determined career planning and professional development
  • A corporate culture in which there is enough room for innovative thinking - to find the best solution together, not the quickest one
  • A large number of committed people with a wide range of skills, talents and experience
  • The benefits of a successful global corporation with the collegial culture of a medium-sized company

title: Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
About Persistent

We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654.4M FY26 revenue with 17.4% Y-o-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3.2% Q-o-Q and 16.2% Y-o-Y growth. Our 27,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2026.

About Position

We are hiring a Product Owner with strong Lending (LOS) domain expertise to drive product vision, prioritize features, and lead Agile delivery. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into impactful solutions, ensuring seamless product execution and enhanced customer experience in a fast-paced fintech environment. Please mention a brief description of the position.

  • Role: Product Owner
  • Location: Any PSL Location
  • Experience: 6 to 10 Years
  • Job Type: Full Time Employment

What You'll Do

  • Assess business value, develop business cases, and prioritize epics, stories, and themes aligned with product vision and strategic goals.
  • Define and manage product deliveries, release plans, and feature scope in collaboration with platform leadership.
  • Draft product objectives and strategies, leveraging data-driven insights for decision-making.
  • Define and track KPIs; utilize analytics, A/B testing, and user feedback to refine product features.
  • Convert functional specifications into actionable user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
  • Own, maintain, and refine the product backlog; lead backlog grooming and sprint planning sessions.
  • Manage release planning and track progress through development and QA phases in collaboration with the Scrum Master.
  • Lead software gate reviews, including formal and informal handoffs.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders on product visioning and concept development.
  • Translate complex sprint outcomes and technical updates into business-friendly summaries.
  • Act as the voice of the customer across engineering, UX, QA, and business teams.
  • Proactively identify and escalate risks and impediments to program leadership.
  • Ensure understanding of end-to-end customer experience, integrations, and technical dependencies.
  • Drive continuous improvement in product development practices.
  • Thrive in a collaborative, team-oriented culture with shared accountability.

Expertise You'll Bring

  • Experience working as a Product Owner or in a similar role within software product development.
  • Strong domain knowledge in Lending (LOS mandatory) and familiarity with LMS systems.
  • Solid understanding of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban); SAFe experience is a plus.
  • Proven ability to write clear user stories and translate business requirements into technical specifications.
  • Hands-on experience collaborating with engineering, QA, UX, and cross-functional teams.
  • Product Owner certification preferred; Scrum Master certification is an added advantage.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
  • Advanced English communication skills (B2+ or higher).
  • Prior experience in FinTech is a plus.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
  • Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
  • Annual health check-ups
  • Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  • We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
  • Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
  • If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment

Let’s unleash your full potential at Persistent - persistent.com/careers

“Persistent is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind.”

title: Product Strategist / Product Owner / Business Analyst IRC292695
descriptionHtml:
Description

Experience Range: 9-12 Years

About the Role: We are looking for an experienced Product Owner to lead the continuous development of the platform. In this role, you will help build a solution that provides drug manufacturers with an efficient, single point of access to distribute limited distribution drugs (LDDs) through the most clinically expert channels. Our platform aggregates real-world data, supports advanced therapy management programs, and integrates deeply with health system EMR infrastructure to deliver superior patient outcomes and reduce the total cost of care. Furthermore, you will be instrumental in identifying and integrating AI enhancement capabilities wherever needed to optimize operational processes and elevate patient care outcomes.

Requirements

What You Will Own (Key Platform Capabilities):

As the Product Owner, you will drive the roadmap, backlog, and feature execution for critical platform functionalities, including:


  • AI & Process Optimization: Leveraging AI enhancement capabilities across the platform wherever needed to streamline operational workflows, automate complex processes, and drive better patient care outcomes.
  • Data & Analytics: Centralized data aggregation and reporting across a national network of health system specialty pharmacies, alongside real-world drug usage analytics and insights for manufacturer partners.
  • EMR Integration: EMR-integrated therapy management and adherence programs delivered right at the point of care.
  • Compliance & Safety: Comprehensive adverse event (AE) capture and reporting to support post-market pharmacovigilance, as well as REMS (Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy) implementation and management for complex drugs.
  • Patient & Payer Services: Features enabling prior authorization coordination, patient financial advocacy services, and consultative payer relationship management for better reimbursement outcomes.


Job responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Roadmap


  • Define and own the product roadmap for the specialty pharmacy network platform, aligning with organizational strategy and manufacturer, payer, and health system needs
  • Translate complex healthcare workflows — including LDD distribution, REMS management, and therapy management — into clear product requirements and user stories.
  • Stay ahead of industry trends in specialty pharmacy, value-based care, and ACO models to inform product direction.
  • Champion a patient-centered product philosophy, ensuring every feature decision prioritizes care continuity and clinical outcomes.


Stakeholder Collaboration


  • Act as primary product liaison between clinical teams, engineering, drug manufacturer partners, payer contacts, and health system network members.
  • Facilitate requirements-gathering sessions with specialists, pharmacy coordinators, Patient Financial Advocates (PFAs), and therapy management nurses
  • Manage competing priorities across a diverse stakeholder ecosystem including manufacturers, IDNs, payers, and internal operations
  • Build strong relationships with manufacturer partners and health system members to identify product improvement opportunities


Backlog Management & Execution


  • Own and maintain a prioritized product backlog; write detailed, actionable user stories with acceptance criteria
  • Partner with engineering and UX teams through agile sprint cycles to deliver high-quality product increments
  • Define, measure, and report on key product KPIs including therapy initiation rates, adherence outcomes, AE reporting completeness, and data accuracy
  • Ensure data aggregation pipelines and manufacturer-facing analytics meet contractual and quality standards


Compliance & Quality


  • Ensure product solutions support full compliance with REMS documentation requirements, specialty pharmacy accreditation standards (URAC), and applicable regulations.
  • Collaborate with compliance and clinical teams to embed adverse event reporting and safety monitoring into product workflows
  • Support audit readiness for LDD contract requirements and manufacturer program specifications.


Data & Analytics


  • Drive development of real-world data products that provide manufacturers with actionable insights on drug utilization, adherence, and clinical outcomes
  • Define data quality standards across the network and ensure consistent operating procedures are reflected in system design
  • Partner with data engineering teams to build aggregated, de-identified data feeds that meet manufacturer and payer reporting needs


What we offer

Exciting Projects: We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.

Collaborative Environment: You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!

Work-Life Balance: GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.

Professional Development: Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.

Excellent Benefits: We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.

Fun Perks: We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!

About GlobalLogic

GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

title: Product Owner Traine
descriptionHtml:
About Ariqt

Ariqt Global Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a fast-growing software services company dedicated to delivering financial solutions, mobile applications, AI-driven products, and other cutting-edge technology services. Our team thrives on innovation, creativity, and a commitment to excellence. With a strong international client base, we focus on building scalable, high-quality digital products and impactful technology solutions.

Join us to grow your career in a dynamic, collaborative, and global tech environment.

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly motivated Technical Product Owner (TPO) Trainee to join our product and technology team. This opportunity is ideal for recent graduates or candidates with up to 1 year of experience who have a strong technical background and an interest in product management, business analysis, and software development lifecycle processes.

As a TPO Trainee, you will work closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Developers, QA Engineers, and stakeholders to understand business requirements, define product features, manage user stories, and support the successful delivery of software products. This role provides hands-on exposure to product planning, Agile methodologies, requirement gathering, and technology-driven problem-solving.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist in gathering, analyzing, and documenting business and product requirements.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand customer needs and translate them into functional requirements.
  • Support the creation and management of user stories, acceptance criteria, and product backlogs.
  • Work closely with development and QA teams to clarify requirements and ensure smooth product delivery.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Track feature development progress and help ensure timely delivery of project milestones.
  • Assist in product testing, validation, and user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Conduct market, competitor, and product research to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Prepare product documentation, workflows, process diagrams, and release notes.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment between business goals and technical implementation.
  • Learn and contribute to product roadmap planning and prioritization activities.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics & Communication, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or related technical disciplines.
  • 0–1 year of experience (Freshers are encouraged to apply).
  • Strong understanding of software development concepts and technology fundamentals.
  • Basic knowledge of SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) and Agile methodologies.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.
  • Ability to understand technical concepts and communicate them effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and documentation tools.

title: Senior Product Owner, Enterprise Solutions
descriptionHtml:
About ACA:

ACA Group is the leading governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) advisor in financial services. We empower our clients to reimagine GRC and protect and grow their business. Our innovative approach integrates consulting, managed services, and our ComplianceAlpha® technology platform with the specialized expertise of former regulators and practitioners and our deep understanding of the global regulatory landscape.

Position Summary:

The Senior Product Owner will lead the strategy and execution of the quote-to-cash product ecosystem, bridging back-office financial operations with modern business agility. This role owns platforms including Salesforce.com, Workday, and Certinia and is responsible for defining and delivering an integrated product vision across these systems.

The Senior Product Owner operates with a high degree of autonomy and accountability, driving roadmap development, aligning cross-functional stakeholders, and ensuring delivery of scalable, high-impact solutions. This role partners closely with Finance, Operations, and Technology leaders to translate business priorities into a strategic product roadmap and measurable outcomes. The role is also responsible for identifying opportunities to leverage AI, automation, data, and emerging technologies to improve operational efficiency, scalability, and business outcomes across the quote-to-cash ecosystem.

Job Duties:


  • Own and drive the end-to-end product strategy, roadmap, and backlog across the quote-to-cash ecosystem
  • Lead prioritization decisions balancing business value, risk, and operational efficiency
  • Partner with senior leaders across Finance, Technology, and Operations to define product direction and investment priorities
  • Translate complex business, customer, and technical requirements into scalable product solutions
  • Lead backlog refinement and sprint planning; facilitate cross-functional alignment at both working and leadership levels
  • Influence and negotiate vendor roadmaps to align third-party capabilities with ACA’s needs
  • Act as the primary decision-maker for product tradeoffs, ensuring alignment between short-term delivery and long-term strategy
  • Represent the voice of the business and end user within agile teams and provide clarity on priorities and acceptance criteria
  • Drive process improvement and change management across financial and sales operations
  • Develop mockups, prototypes, and business cases to support strategic decisions
  • Define and track KPIs and business outcome metrics to measure success and inform roadmap decisions
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to less experienced product owners or analysts and help elevate product practices across the organization
  • Partner with business and technology leaders to identify, prioritize, and deliver AI, automation, and digital transformation initiatives that improve operational effectiveness and user experience.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Engineering, and Data teams to define integration, reporting, and data governance strategies across Salesforce, Workday, Certinia, and related enterprise platforms.

Required Education and Experience:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
  • 7–10+ years of progressively responsible experience in product ownership, business analysis, or related roles (updated from 5+)
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional product initiatives
  • Strong domain expertise in financial systems and sales/back-office operations
  • Experience working with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Workday, Certinia, or similar

Skills & Attributes:


  • Strategic thinking and ability to translate business objectives into product roadmaps
  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment across competing priorities
  • Strong facilitation skills, including leading cross-functional and leadership-level discussions
  • Ability to balance long-term platform strategy with near-term delivery needs
  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving capabilities
  • Demonstrated success delivering measurable business outcomes using technology
  • Strong communication skills across both business and technical audiences
  • High level of ownership, initiative, and accountability

What working at ACA offers:

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. Our Total Rewards package includes medical coverage fully funded by ACA for employees and their family as well as access to Maternity & Fertility and Wellness programs. ACA also provides Personal Accident Insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Employee Discount programs and Employee Resource Groups. You’ll be granted time off for designated ACA Paid Holidays, Privilege Leave, Casual/Sick Leave, and other leaves of absence to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

What we commit to:

ACA is firmly committed to a policy of nondiscrimination, which applies to recruiting, hiring, placement, promotions, training, discipline, terminations, layoffs, transfers, leaves of absence, compensation and all other terms and conditions of employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or protected veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

descriptionHtml:
About CleanHarbors

Clean Harbors Inc. (www.cleanharbors.com) is a NYSE listed US based $6.5 billion company. Clean Harbors was founded in 1980 near Boston by Mr. Alan S. McKim.

Everywhere industry meets environment, Clean Harbors is on-site, providing premier environmental, energy and industrial services. Clean Harbors employs a dedicated workforce of 25,000 employees and has over 750 service locations across the U.S., Canada and Mexico. Beyond addressing the environmental needs of its more than 300,000 customers, the Company has been on the front lines of addressing some of the largest emergency response events in North America of the past several decades including the BP Oil Spill in the Gulf of Mexico, the anthrax attacks in New York, the 2015 avian flu outbreak that devastated the poultry industry, Hurricanes Katrina, Rita and Sandy, and the oil pipeline breaks that affected the Yellowstone and Kalamazoo rivers, along with other major chemical releases into the environment.

Clean Harbors India has been strategically established as the Global Capability Center (GCC) to serve our parent company. We take pride in serving some of the most tech savvy business stakeholders at Clean Harbors. The GCC employees form part of our globally integrated teams that provide cutting-edge IT solutions and production support across platforms. Our shared services teams work seamlessly with their global counterparts in providing critical 24x7 support in various functions including Finance, HR, Procurement, IT and Operations. Our aggressive growth plans open significant career advancement opportunities for our employees.

Job Title: Product Owner – AI Enabled Product Development

Experience: 12+ Years with Min 5 years as Product Owner

Location: Hyderabad, Hybrid

Working Hours: 12.00pm to 9.00pm

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with engineering teams to implement new features and improvements
  • Understands UX/UI components, wire-framing elements and design. Knowledge of Figma. Lucid, etc..
  • Apply prompt engineering techniques for wire-framing and design.
  • Excellent verbal/written communication skills and presenting ideas in group setting.
  • Prior experience with Atlassian products including JIRA and Confluence
  • Authors Epics and Stories with detailed acceptance criteria for enhancement requests that address stakeholder business problems
  • Works closely with delivery teams & business analysts to translate business requirements into workable product backlogs
  • Partners closely with the Scrum Masters on sprint planning, including prioritizing stories that have the highest business value and are aligned with enterprise standards and business roadmaps.
  • Use lean, iterative experiments and low-fidelity prototyping to find signal, validate hypothesis, and iterate before moving to scale
  • Collaborate with partners to define end-state architecture and drive secure, resilient, performant, and scalable technology solutions
  • Assess opportunities for reusing enterprise solutions and build new platforms with enterprise scalability in mind
  • Develop and maintain an appropriately prioritized backlog of user stories for implementation. A keen curiosity about emerging tools and technologies
  • Understands the enterprise IT processes and works closely with stakeholders to identify appropriate solutions to business problems.
  • Determines scope, estimates work effort, and determines duration of development activities.
  • Designs solutions to meet business requirements and works in close coordination with architects and delivery leads to drive solutions to production
  • Owns and updates the product vision and roadmaps.
  • Collaborates with the agile team to prepare the estimates for the user stories within the product backlog.
  • Conducts the formal review and acceptance of user stories implemented by the agile team within a sprint.
  • Drives the execution of user acceptance testing (UAT) activities with support from business and technology team members.
  • Provides daily support to the application / Product platform; including, integrations and administration

Qualifications

Required Skills

  • Proven experience as a Technology Product Owner in developing tech platforms for underwriting, and policy lifecycle processes or Insurtech, with a solid understanding of insurance products, processes, and customer needs.
  • Demonstrate ability to combine deep business and product knowledge with technical know-how
  • Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies and experience working within cross-functional Agile teams.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at various levels.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on delivering user-centered products.
  • Ability to independently plan deliverables and coordinate with team-members.
  • Team player - friendly, communicative, open, honest, thoughtful, and committed.
  • Ability to work cooperatively with others, sharing ideas, collaborating and ultimately, putting team goals first.
  • Experience mentoring and coaching others
  • Demonstrated documentation experience in creating rich content that explains business requirements – usage of various documentation tools is a must

Recommended

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Software or other Technical degree.
  • 10+ experience in IT field, 5+ years minimum working as a Product Owner in IT field, with at least 3+ years as Technology Product Owner.
  • Demonstrated experience with building software products using agile methodologies
