Job TITLE

Product Owner

General Summary

The Product Owner will have a technical focus and work with product managers, internal stakeholders, 3rd-party partners, and customers to gain a thorough understanding of their product and market needs, translating them into feature stories and tasks for development. You will be responsible for turning the product vision into an actionable backlog and advocating the customers’ needs to the development team.

The Product Owner is responsible for the development backlog, grooming, and acceptance. This individual will execute converting the product vision and roadmap into workable product requirements for engineering to meet product roadmap expectations defined by the Product Manager. This role will report to the Manager, Product Management – [product line] and will regularly engage with cross-functional leaders.

The ideal candidate must be well-versed in agile scrum and comfortable working in all aspects of a multifaceted delivery network. You will demonstrate excellent problem-solving skills, be self-motivated and detail-oriented, and be a good team player. Other duties include prioritization of key backlog items that drive growth and success, developing supporting documentation, and keeping customers and stakeholders informed of the status of the product.

ROLES & REPONSIBILITIES

  • Owns and prioritizes the sprint backlog for assigned platform and technical domains, balancing technical debt, reliability, and roadmap commitments
  • Translates platform and technical requirements into well-defined epics, user stories, technical specification and acceptance criteria
  • Converts product vision into actional backlog items that deliver platform enablement, reliability, scalability and technical debt reduction
  • Participates in sprint planning, grooming, retrospectives and reviews for assigned technical and platform teams
  • Works with Product Management, Engineering leads, architects and security teams to support platform decisions that are technically sound and aligned with product direction
  • Communicates platform capability needs to the development team and represents technical requirements in prioritization decisions
  • Supports and utilizes technical discovery with Engineering leads and internal platform consumers to inform backlog priorities
  • Communicates platform capability releases to internal consumers and Engineering teams in coordination with Product and Technology leadership
  • Serves as a subject matter expert for assigned platform and technical domains, supporting Engineering onboarding tooling, and organizational education
  • Escalates technical risks, platform dependencies and roadmap gaps to Product leadership proactively
  • Maintains regular alignment with the Product Manager and Product Leadership on roadmap priorities, backlog direction, and technical outcomes; raises conflicts between technical demands and roadmap commitments proactively
  • Maintains a minimum of two sprints of groomed and estimated backlog at all times for assigned tea upms.
  • Contributes to epic-level roadmap tracking across quarters in coordination with the Product Manager and/or Manager of Product Management for assigned domains
  • Participates in pod-level planning, estimation sessions and steerco readouts as required
  • Ability to travel up to 20%

KEY COMPETENCIES

  • Balance of technical knowledge and business acumen
  • Provides updates on backlog health, spring progress and delivery risks to the Product Manager and/or Manager of Product Management to support roadmap tracking and stakeholder communication
  • Customer first mind set
  • Backlog execution – prioritizes and manages the spring backlog in alignment with the product roadmap defined by the Product Manager and/or Manager of Product Management
  • Proactive, self-starter with excellent project management skills and ability to manage multiple tasks effectively
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to engage, influence, and inspire partners and stakeholders to drive collaboration and alignment
  • High degree of organization, individual initiative, and personal accountability
  • Ability to assess risks, dependencies and propose mitigation strategies to overcome obstacles
  • Skilled in leading meetings, setting agendas, driving decisions, and negotiating.

REQUIRED Qualifications, EDUCATION, CERTIFICATES And Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree and 4 years of professional experience, preferably in product ownership, project management or business analysis
  • At least 1 year of experience in Product Management and/or Product Development
  • Established background in launching software services in partnership with Engineering teams and high degree of proficiency in prototyping, iterative development and experience working within an Agile scrum team environment

PREFERRED Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare IT, supply chain, or SaaS environments
  • Familiarity with JIRA, Confluence, AI-assisted product tools, and agile tooling
  • Experience in platform and integration-oriented technical domains

GHX: It's the way you do business in healthcare

Global Healthcare Exchange (GHX) enables better patient care and billions in savings for the healthcare community by maximizing automation, efficiency and accuracy of business processes.

GHX is a healthcare business and data automation company, empowering healthcare organizations to enable better patient care and maximize industry savings using our world class cloud-based supply chain technology exchange platform, solutions, analytics and services. We bring together healthcare providers and manufacturers and distributors in North America and Europe - who rely on smart, secure healthcare-focused technology and comprehensive data to automate their business processes and make more informed decisions.

It is our passion and vision for a more operationally efficient healthcare supply chain, helping organizations reduce - not shift - the cost of doing business, paving the way to delivering patient care more effectively. Together we take more than a billion dollars out of the cost of delivering healthcare every year. GHX is privately owned, operates in the United States, Canada and Europe, and employs more than 1000 people worldwide. Our corporate headquarters is in Colorado, with additional offices in Europe.

GHX expects and requires the cooperation of all employees in maintaining a discrimination and harassment-free atmosphere. title: Associate Director - Strategic Partnerships (AI-Led Payments)
descriptionHtml:
We at Pine Labs are looking for those who share our core belief - “Every Day is Game day”. We bring our best selves to work each day to realize our mission of enriching the world through the power of digital commerce and financial services.


Role Purpose:

We are hiring an Associate Director, Strategic Partnerships, AI-led Payments, who will work closely with Sales Leadership to drive adoption of Pine Labs' emerging AI-powered payment and commerce solutions. This role sits at the intersection of sales, product, and technology, and focuses on translating complex AI capabilities into tangible business value for enterprise clients.

You will partner with senior sales leaders to shape client conversations, co-sell solutions, and build early market traction for agentic and AI-enabled payment products. This is a high-ownership role suited for individuals who can operate in evolving environments and contribute to building a new category of solutions.

Pine Labs is expanding its product portfolio to include AI-led and agentic commerce solutions that integrate intelligence into payment and financial workflows. As these products move from development to market, there is a clear need to enable enterprise adoption through solution-led selling. This requires translating new and evolving capabilities into clear, outcome-driven value propositions for large corporates and merchants. The role will support sales leadership in building this narrative, driving early adoption, and shaping go-to-market approaches for AI-enabled payment solutions.


Responsibilities we entrust you with:

  • Drive adoption of AI-led payment and commerce solutions across large enterprise clients and merchants
  • Enable successful conversion of strategic deals through solution-oriented selling and co-creation with clients
  • Establish clear, repeatable value propositions and use case narratives for AI-enabled payment offerings
  • Strengthen alignment between Sales, Product, and Engineering through structured feedback from client engagements
  • Contribute to building a scalable go-to-market approach for emerging AI products within Pine Labs
  • Partner with Sales Leaders to co-own and drive strategic client engagements for AI-led payment solutions
  • Translate product capabilities into client-specific solutions aligned to business objectives and outcomes
  • Participate in client discussions, presentations, and workshops to articulate value propositions and use cases
  • Support deal structuring including solution scope, commercials, and implementation approach
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to relay client feedback and refine offerings
  • Build industry-specific use-case narratives and solution playbooks to enable broader sales adoption
  • Track key deal progress, identify risks, and proactively drive closure in partnership with sales stakeholders


What matters in this role:

  • 6 to 12 years of experience in pre-sales, solutioning, consulting, or enterprise sales roles
  • Demonstrated transition into or exposure to full-cycle enterprise sales or strategic account management
  • Experience selling SaaS, fintech, or technology-led solutions to large enterprises preferred
  • Educational background from a reputable institution preferred
  • Proven ability to engage with multiple stakeholders in complex sales environments
  • Familiarity with SaaS, fintech, or platform-based business models
  • Exposure to payments, financial services, or emerging technology solutions
  • Comfort working in ambiguous, fast-evolving product environments


Growth & Exposure:

This role offers the opportunity to work at the forefront of AI-led commerce and payments, contributing to the early stages of category creation within Pine Labs. You will gain exposure to enterprise clients, cross-functional teams, and strategic initiatives that shape future product and go-to-market directions. The role provides a platform to build deep expertise in solution selling, emerging technologies, and large-scale commercial engagements


What Will Help You Succeed:

  • Ability to operate effectively in environments where products and narratives are still evolving
  • Comfort taking ownership and driving outcomes without fully defined playbooks
  • Strong curiosity and willingness to understand emerging technologies and their business applications
  • Practical, client-first mindset with focus on solving real business problems



What we Value in Our people

  • You take the shot: You Decide Fast and You Deliver Right
  • You are the CEO of what you do: you show ownership and make things happen
  • You own tomorrow: by building solutions for the merchants and doing the right thing
  • You sign your work like an artist: You seek to learn and take pride in the work you do

title: Associate Director- Product Design (UI UX) - Immediate joiners preferred
descriptionHtml:
Designation: Associate Design Director: Product & AI Experiences

Location: Andheri West


We don't need another designer. We need someone who can walk into ambiguity, find the real problem, create clarity, align people around a direction, and ship products that move businesses forward. We are looking for a product leader who understands that AI is changing how products are discovered, used, and experienced. Someone who can help clients move beyond screens and workflows to create intelligent, adaptive, and AI-native experiences. If your biggest strength is making beautiful screens, this role is probably not for you. If your biggest strength is solving problems, challenging assumptions, leading people, and creating products that customers actually adopt, keep reading.


What We Believe


Technology was never the problem. Most enterprises already have plenty of it. The problem is that products are often built around systems, departments, and requirements instead of customers, behaviour, and outcomes. At BOMBAYDC, we help enterprises build intelligent digital platforms for the AI era. We work at the intersection of strategy, product thinking, design, behavioural science, and engineering. The next generation of products will not be defined by interfaces alone. They will be defined by intelligence. AI is changing how people search, decide, buy, learn, and interact with products. We believe the best product leaders will not simply design screens, they will design systems where human, business, and machine intelligence work together to create better outcomes.


The Person We Are Looking For


  • Thinks in outcomes, not deliverables.
  • Questions brief instead of blindly executing them.
  • Can translate business goals into product direction.
  • Has strong product judgement and systems thinking.
  • Can influence clients, stakeholders, and teams.
  • Raises the quality of everyone around them.
  • Uses AI as a force multiplier for thinking, research, prototyping, and execution.
  • Understands how AI is reshaping customer behaviour, products, and businesses.
  • Takes ownership, stays curious, and never stops learning.


Your Mission


You will lead some of the most important work inside the company. You will:


  • Own product strategy and experience direction for large engagements.
  • Turn ambiguous client problems into clear product opportunities.
  • Work directly with founders, enterprise CXOs, designers, and engineers.
  • Mentor teams and raise the quality of product thinking across the company.
  • Help enterprises rethink products and experiences for an AI-native future.
  • Shape intelligent experiences where AI enhances customer outcomes and business performance.
  • Drive adoption, retention, and measurable business outcomes, not just design outputs.


What Success Looks Like After 12 months


  • Clients trust your judgement without needing founder intervention.
  • Designers seek your guidance because you consistently improve their work.
  • Projects become sharper, faster, and more outcome-driven.
  • You uncover product and AI opportunities others miss.
  • You become a force multiplier for both the company and our clients.

What We Do Care About


  • Product thinking.
  • Leadership.
  • Systems thinking.
  • Business understanding.
  • Communication.
  • Curiosity.
  • Craft.
  • AI fluency.
  • AI-native ways of working.


What We Don't Care About


  • Fancy process without impact.
  • UX buzzwords.
  • Portfolios that only showcase visuals.
  • Waiting for instructions.
  • Blaming clients, developers, or stakeholders.


3 Great Reasons To Work With Us


We are small but global. Our multidisciplinary team has worked in Mumbai, Barcelona, London, Stockholm, and Tokyo. Get it right, and you'll work with some of the best talent in the world. To us, people are everything. Your growth is as important to us as it is to you. While we don't have beer taps (yet!), we've created a restriction-free, high-energy environment where people can do their best work. Our larger purpose? We believe design and technology can contribute to a better life and a better India. Our ultimate goal is to harness creativity for national development while pursuing excellence in both arts and technology.


Benefits @ BOMBAYDC


  • Stay close to your family: Work for up to 2 weeks each year from your hometown if you've relocated to Mumbai.
  • Breathe easy with lesser travel: If your commute exceeds 60 minutes one way, you can work from home every Tuesday and Thursday after confirmation.
  • We protect your Grey Matter: Our HR team is always available to support, listen, and counsel whenever needed.
  • Winter Break: Enjoy an extended year-end break to spend quality time with family and recharge.
  • Extended Long Weekends: We thoughtfully design our holiday calendar to give you more opportunities to unwind.
  • Caregiver Leave: Take time off or work remotely when family members need your care during medical emergencies.
  • We Invest in You: Through learning subsidies, mentorship opportunities, and direct access to founders.
  • We Appreciate Performance: Through Project Excellence Awards and milestone celebrations throughout your journey with us.

Who This Role Is Perfect For


  • Someone who has spent years designing products and now wants a bigger canvas.
  • Someone who wants influence, ownership, and responsibility.
  • Someone who wants to help build the next generation of intelligent digital products.
  • Someone who could eventually become a Pod Head, Associate Partner, or future leader within BOMBAYDC.


Self-Test


If you read this and thought:


  • That's exactly how I think.
  • I already operate this way.
  • I want more ownership than my current role gives me.
  • I care more about solving problems


We should talk

At RTX, the world largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. Pratt & Whitney is a world leader in the design, manufacture and service of aircraft engines and auxiliary power systems and has been revolutionizing modern flight for over 100 years. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

As Product Owner, you will work with the Product Manager for Customer 360 (C360) and the development team to ensure C360 meets the needs of its users to ultimately better serve our customers.

What You Will Do:

  • The C360 Product Owner supports the C360 Product Manager by interfacing with the development team.

  • Gathering or clarifying business requirements

  • Support agile process: daily scrums, sprint plannings, retros and backlog refinement.

Expectations of the Role:

  • Ability to independently manage small features

title: R&D Product Owner – GPQSS Digital & Service - IDC
descriptionHtml:
The opportunity

We are looking for a proactive and customer-focused Product Owner for R&D Service Projects to drive the definition, delivery, and continuous improvement of service-related digital and technical solutions. The role acts as the key interface between business stakeholders, service organizations, customers, and development teams to ensure that service products and solutions deliver measurable value across the lifecycle.

You will be part of Service & Digital organization, working in a global, cross-functional environment and reporting to the relevant R&D leadership in Grid & Power Quality Solutions and Service. This is a visible role with strong influence on service innovation, operational excellence, and digital transformation at scale, living and exercising Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity.

How You’ll Make An Impact

  • You will own and manage the product backlog for digital service-related projects, translating service needs, customer requirements, and strategic objectives into clear, prioritized user stories and features. You will act as the project manager for relevant projects, and you will work closely with global service organizations, other R&D project managers, digital, quality, cybersecurity functions, and operations teams to ensure alignment between product vision, service delivery, and execution.
  • You will be responsible for defining release plans for service solutions, ensuring value-driven prioritization and timely delivery. You will actively engage with stakeholders to gather, clarify, and validate requirements, balancing business value, technical feasibility, risk, and compliance considerations. You will support agile execution by participating in sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives, providing timely clarifications and acceptance of delivered functionality.
  • You will ensure traceability of requirements, KPIs, and outcomes across the service lifecycle, including development, deployment, operation, and continuous improvement. You will proactively monitor progress, dependencies, and risks, and take corrective actions in collaboration with project managers and delivery teams when deviations occur.
  • You will provide regular status updates on development activities to stakeholders and ensure they remain well‑informed. You will ensure the post‑release transition of the solution to the product team.
  • You will contribute to the definition and continuous improvement of service processes, digital workflows, and project management practices to increase efficiency and scalability. You will ensure that service solutions comply with applicable internal and external regulations, quality standards, cybersecurity requirements, and governance frameworks.
  • Responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
  • Living Hitachi Energy’s core values safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

Your Background

  • Required bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering (Computer Science, IT, Electrical, or related field). Relevant experience in software development or digital engineering projects.
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and engineering best practices. Ability to work in an agile and collaborative team environment. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Proven ability to take ownership and deliver tasks independently.
  • You have several years of experience working as a Product Owner, Project Manager, or similar role, with a strong focus on digital solutions development. Experience working with digitally enabled service-oriented products, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement in domains such as grid, power electronics, industrial automation, or digital transformation is highly valued.
  • Technical literacy in software architectures, APIs, cloud platforms, data flows, security, and integration constraints, in supporting informed decision-making. Strong understanding of product ownership within agile or hybrid delivery models, including backlog management, user stories, prioritization techniques, and acceptance criteria.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams, including R&D, service, operations, quality, cybersecurity, and business stakeholders. Familiarity with service delivery processes, SLAs, KPIs, and value measurement for service and digital solutions.
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution, translating high-level objectives into actionable deliverables. Experience working with governance frameworks, quality gates, and compliance requirements within product or service development organizations. You work in a structured way, applying relevant methods, tools, and documentation practices to ensure clarity and transparency. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex topics in a clear and pragmatic way. A strong sense of ownership, accountability, and customer focus, with the ability to influence without formal authority.
  • Excellent spoken and written communication skills in English. Experience in using tools/applications such as Azure DevOps, Microsoft Office, MS Project, and SAP for day‑to‑day activities.
  • Good communication skills with the ability to interact with global stakeholders.


More About Us

Excited about a new opportunity? If this sounds like you, we’d like to see your application! Our selection process is ongoing, so don’t wait—apply today!

title: Product Owner - Yardi
descriptionHtml:
Job Responsibilities

  • Define the product vision, roadmap, and backlog for Yardi capabilities and integrations aligned to Investment Accounting and/or Multifamily priorities.
  • Align regional business, operations, finance, and technology stakeholders on priorities, outcomes, and delivery sequencing across the global operating model.
  • Translate business needs into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and delivery plans for Yardi modules and adjacent systems.
  • Lead end-to-end delivery for Yardi modules including discovery, design, testing, release readiness, and change management.
  • Configure and administer Yardi security, workflows, chart of accounts, bank and GL setup, and multi-entity structures to meet control and audit requirements.
  • Design and govern integrations between Yardi and downstream platforms using secure file exchange, ETL, and APIs, including mappings, lineage, and reconciliations.
  • Build and enhance reporting using Yardi Standard Reporting and SQL-based extracts while defining KPIs and ensuring metric consistency and data quality.
  • Drive release and environment management including patching, upgrades, regression testing, vendor coordination, incident triage, and SLA oversight.
  • Apply AI and data-driven analytics to prioritize work, automate workflows, improve data quality, and generate actionable stakeholder insights.
  • Standardize global processes and controls while accommodating local market requirements across regions and regulatory contexts.
  • Mentor teammates on product thinking, analytical reasoning, AI literacy, and stakeholder communication to strengthen Agile execution and continuous improvement.


Required qualifications, capabilities and skills

  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on Yardi experience (Voyager and/or Investment Accounting) in production, including configuration, module setup, user administration, and reporting.
  • Minimum 10 years of overall experience delivering enterprise technology in product management, solutions/business analysis, or a closely related role with VP-level scope.
  • Deep domain expertise in Investment Accounting and/or Multifamily operations on Yardi (e.g., funds/vehicles, capital activity, waterfalls, consolidations; leasing/resident lifecycle where applicable).
  • Demonstrated ownership of at least one Yardi implementation, major upgrade, or multi-module optimization from requirements through stabilization.
  • Proficiency with Yardi reporting (YSR) and custom extracts with strong SQL skills for validation, reconciliation, and analytics.
  • Experience designing and supporting integrations between Yardi and finance/analytics platforms using file-based, ETL, and/or API patterns.
  • AI proficiency with hands-on experience identifying, prioritizing, and deploying AI/ML solutions and establishing responsible-use standards and guardrails.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to drive alignment and decisions across diverse, global groups.

title: Technical Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
Join us as a Technical Product Owner at Barclays, responsible for supporting the successful delivery of Location Strategy projects to plan, budget, agreed quality and governance standards. You'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You will harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings, ensuring unparalleled customer experiences.

To be successful Technical Product Owner you should have experience with:


  • Leading cross-functional teams to deliver digital products or features from concept to launch
  • Collaborating with technology, Design, UX research, operations and business stakeholders to define and prioritize product backlogs
  • Translating customer insights and business objectives into actionable Features, User stories and acceptance criteria
  • Chasing different digital metrices to understand the impact of the feature on banks Net returns as well enhancing customer experience.
  • Making sure competitive analysis and UX research is done for every feature.
  • Experience with process tools like MS Visio, Draw.io, JIRA, Confluence, Figma
  • Proficiency in creating detailed functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria
  • Ability to engage with engineering teams and understand APIs, architecture, and integration patterns.
  • Ability to define and maintain product roadmaps, write clear and actionable user stories, and translate complex requirements into deliverable features.
  • Strong analytical background with experience using data to inform product strategy and prioritization.
  • Skilled in working with design, compliance, operations, and third-party vendors to deliver cohesive, customer-centric payment experiences


Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include


  • Cards domain specifically Co-branded credit card domain expertise and understanding E2E flows, industry standards, and evolving technologies such as open banking, digital wallets, real-time payments and relevant regulations like PSD2.
  • Experience in the financial services or banking sector, especially in digital transformation initiatives
  • Familiarity with regulatory and compliance considerations in consumer banking products
  • Certified in Scaled Agile (e.g., SAFe), with a track record of leading agile teams, facilitating ceremonies, and driving iterative delivery in a fast-paced environment.


You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role is based in Pune.

Purpose of the role

To support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by the identification of business requirements and solutions that address business problems and opportunities.

Accountabilities


  • Identification and analysis of business problems and client requirements that require change within the organisation.
  • Development of business requirements that will address business problems and opportunities.
  • Collaboration with stakeholders to ensure that proposed solutions meet their needs and expectations.
  • Support the creation of business cases that justify investment in proposed solutions.
  • Conduct feasibility studies to determine the viability of proposed solutions.
  • Support the creation of reports on project progress to ensure proposed solutions are delivered on time and within budget.
  • Creation of operational design and process design to ensure that proposed solutions are delivered within the agreed scope.
  • Support to change management activities, including development of a traceability matrix to ensure proposed solutions are successfully implemented and embedded in the organisation.


Analyst Expectations


  • To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
  • Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
  • Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
  • They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
  • If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
  • OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
  • Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
  • Partner with other functions and business areas.
  • Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
  • Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
  • Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
  • Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
  • Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
  • Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
  • Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
  • Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
  • Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
  • Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
  • Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.


All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Associate Director, IRRBB, Treasury India
descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Associate Director, IRRBB, Treasury India

Location: Bangalore, India

Perm/Contract/ Full-time/Part-time: Permanent

On-site/Hybrid/Remote: On-site


Who We Are

Robert Walters is the world’s most trusted talent solutions business. Across the globe, we deliver recruitment, outsourcing, and talent advisory services for businesses of all sizes, opening doors for people with diverse skills, ambitions, and backgrounds.


Our Outsourcing service delivers recruitment for some of the world’s top employers, and we are currently recruiting on behalf of one our client which is a leading international banking group, with a presence in 54 of the world’s most dynamic markets. Our purpose is to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, and our heritage and values are expressed in our brand promise, here for good.


The Role

Our client is seeking an Associate Director, IRRBB, Treasury India in the Banking division.

This role offers an exciting opportunity to join a global team, providing top-tier service to existing and prospective clients while expanding the business on a product and global level.


Job Description:

Job Summary

Treasury works closely with senior management, the businesses, Country CEOs / CFOs, and Finance to manage and promote the bank’s liquidity, capital, and balance sheet position. Treasury is laser-focussed on its vision to be “Open, progressive and trusted, working commercially with our partners” to create sustainable value by balancing the supply and demand of liquidity and capital.


Within Treasury (which comprises Capital, Liquidity & Markets), the Treasury Liquidity function is responsible for driving the strategic liquidity agenda and Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Booking (‘IRRBB’).


The Associate Director – IRRBB, India hub will support the Head of IRRBB, India Hub in advancing IRRBB Analytics for overseeing and executing comprehensive internal analyses. The role holder will lead a team dedicated to migrating and centralising global IRRBB processes from Group and Clusters, performing detailed stress tests and scenario analyses, leveraging IRRBB data to provide insightful risk assessments and mitigation strategies. This position requires a deep understanding of IRRBB, strong analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with senior stakeholders across the organization.


Key Responsibilities:

Strategy

  • Keep up to date with the Group’s business strategy (incl. SC Ventures) and ensure the IRRBB frameworks are aligned to that.
  • Partner with Global Head of IRRBB in developing and recommending risk mitigation strategies based on the findings from stress tests and scenario analyses. Ensure that these strategies are effectively communicated and implemented across relevant business units.

Business

  • Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates, with a focus on the Group’s participation in the Digital Assets and platforms space.
  • Provide insights on current and forward looking IRRBB exposures, impact assessments on interest income and actions available for balance sheet optimisation.
  • Lead the engagement with businesses on balance sheet optimisation strategies including but not limited to asset & liability mix to manage IRRBB while optimising returns.

Processes

  • Analytics: Support the newly developed IRRBB analytics capabilities on a regular basis, including operating the RCO IRRBB calculation engine to run bespoke scenarios and extracting and analysing the results, covering key metric including, but not limited to, Weekly NIIS Flash, Hedging Strategy Assessments, Corporate Plan NII impact simulations and PV01 analysis. This will also involve working with CPM and Finance closely to prepare MI slides for relevant committees like GALCO, ALCO and IRRBB Steering Forums.
  • Strategy: Support IRRBB strategy by engaging Treasury Markets on NII sensitivities, hedging performance and P&L forecasting. Support investor relations for quarterly results, including GALCO/ALCO hedging updates, and contribute to annual disclosures through slide preparation, briefing notes, Q&A drafting and investor query responses.
  • Framework & Governance: Support IRRBB governance through preparation of monthly GALCO/ALCO packs with commentary, review of risk metrics and monitoring of group, solo and local limits.   • Modelling & Methodology: Apply and maintain IRRBB models per regulatory requirements, including PTR and CASA assumptions. Review and update IRRBB and structural hedging policies, maintain standards, and perform annual forecasts of NII, EBE, and P2A.   • Structural Hedging: Support the structural hedging in planning, executing, and monitoring hedges, including P&L sign-off and capacity management. Conduct basis risk evaluations, Pillar 2 charge reviews, and prepare Pillar 3 disclosures. Support IRBB-related GIA and audit reviews, ensuring all stress testing aligns with ORF requirements and regulatory expectations.
  • IRRBB Technology Journey: Support delivery of new system rollouts, enhancements and data fixes by providing requirements, validating functionality, and ensuring data accuracy. Collaborate with stakeholders to implement changes efficiently, maintain alignment with IRRBB policy and reporting standards, and drive continuous improvement of systems and processes.

People & Talent

  • Be part of a diverse team of skilled and experienced professionals in India.
  • Collaborate within Treasury and with key partners in Finance, CPM, Technology, and Change in India and the clusters.
  • Lead by example in reinforcing the appropriate culture and values of the function.

Risk Management

  • Oversee enterprise-wide interest rate risk in the banking book ensuring alignment with risk appetite and regulatory requirements. Monitor, measure and manage exposures, set limits, and perform scenario analysis and stress testing. Maintain robust frameworks, policies and governance, validate models, provide insights for strategic planning and support senior management, GALCO/ALCO and regulators on risk mitigation, reporting and capital optimisation.

Governance

  • Assess the effectiveness arrangements to deliver effective governance, oversight and controls in the IRRBB frameworks and, if necessary, oversee changes in these areas
  • Understand the regulatory framework in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.
  • Contribute to delivering ‘effective governance’ by actively challenging Treasury / Business / Risk counterparts; and willingness to work with the Prudential Regulatory Authority in an open and cooperative manner.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • See Risk Management section above for regulatory deliverables.
  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.


Skills and Experience

  • Degree in Finance (MBA) / Economics / Quantitative fields from a reputed institution.
  • Finance Professionals (Qualified Chartered Accountant) or Certifications like FRM, PRM or CFA is advantageous
  • Over 10+ years proven experience in Treasury Liquidity, Balance Sheet Management, Asset & Liability Management and/or Finance / Risk with strong understanding of FTP, Funding & Liquidity Regulation, Balance Sheet & Sources / Uses of Funding from top-tier banks / consultancy firms
  • Familiarity with banking book and trading book products and their impact on balances sheet, as well as funding requirements that arise from off-balance sheet positions
  • Good knowledge of cash flow modelling, liquidity & IRRBB risk, predictive models, trade simulations and Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP) mechanisms.
  • Experience in data analysis, data architecture, data transformations, building end to end inhouse data flows (pipes) from source to output, in a bank environment is advantageous
  • Ability to understand, define and articulate business requirements in a clear, precise manner (with project management experience is advantageous).
  • Ability to think objectively and commercially to help identify solutions to potential problems or emerging risks on the horizon via funding simulations and contingency planning
  • Experience with writing and presenting qualitative papers and presenting a plan, and reasons for deviations to that plan to Executive/Board level.
  • Ability to scope and conduct data intensive numerical studies and present the results in a concise and clear manner to audiences.
  • Able to work independently yet a great team player.

title: Product Owner-Anaplan Connect
descriptionHtml:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating our wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

Anaplan is looking for a passionate Technical Product Owner to help drive the development of our next generation Planning and Decision Excellence platform. This person will be based in India and be instrumental in the execution of our product strategy, with data-driven and customer-oriented focus. The role will focus on Anaplan Connect API client within data integration area of the Anaplan Platform.

Applicants should have a technical product management background and ideally relevant experience with Anaplan or other equivalent data integration solutions. Applicants would bring experience working with engineering teams to deliver products and solutions to the market, they would have to demonstrate that they will be able to learn a new market and understand the needs of our customers related to all things planning, modelling and analytics.

 

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

 

  • Work with the existing product team to drive end-to-end product experiences: writing user stories with clear acceptance criteria, working with engineering, documentation, support, and marketing to deliver quality experiences.
  • Understand the market for Enterprise Software in general and Anaplan specifically. Be the voice of the customer while understanding the competitive Landscape. Be able to define and segment users of the Anaplan platform qualitatively and quantitatively.
  • Work with the Product leadership, UX, Engineering and other cross-functional teams on roadmap and capacity planning.
  • Creating enablement material including technical & support documents, and video walk throughs.
  • Effectively collaborate across global teams to create alignment between engineering teams and other product stakeholders.
  • Train sales, customer success and support on new features and messaging.
  • Work closely with engineering teams to execute on day-to-day development.
  • Meet with customers, users, prospects, and partners to communicate Anaplan’s product vision, product roadmap, and competitive differentiation. 

 

REQUIREMENTS

 

  • Experience working as a Product Owner in a technology-driven environment, preferably with experience in SaaS or enterprise software companies.
  • Good understanding of data management, API solutions for Enterprise customers.
  • Prior experience in other data management platforms like Databricks, Snowflake, Informatica, Mulesoft or ETL tools.
  • Domain knowledge of Anaplan or other planning solutions.
  • Good understanding of the product management lifecycle and launching new products
  • Proficiency in gathering and analysing market and customer insights.
  • Ability to translate customer needs into actionable product requirements.
  • Experience working in an Agile development environment and familiarity with tools like Jira, Confluence, etc.
  • Experience in creating enablement documentation including technical & support style documents
  • Highly analytical and able to troubleshoot issues quickly; candidates should be able to go from high level to low level very easily
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams
  • Team player with the ability to work autonomously
  • Able and willing to work in a fast paced, quickly changing environment

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  

Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer  

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.  

Anaplan does not:  

  • Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.   
  • Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.  

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

title: Senior Digital Product Owner - Integration Platforms
descriptionHtml:
Career Area

Technology, Digital and Data

Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Overview

Cat Digital is seeking a Senior Product Owner to lead the strategy and delivery of an enterprise integration platform that connects dealer systems, ERP platforms, and digital products across Caterpillar’s global ecosystem.

This role owns the product vision, roadmap, and execution for a high‑scale integration service that enables APIs, event‑driven integrations, and data sharing at enterprise scale. You will work closely with engineering, architecture, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable, scalable integration capabilities.

What You Will Do

Own the Product Vision

  • Define and execute the roadmap for an enterprise‑grade integration platform.
  • Translate business and technical needs into clear product outcomes.
  • Balance platform scalability, reliability, and speed of delivery.

Drive Delivery Excellence

  • Own and prioritize the product backlog across multiple integration initiatives.
  • Define clear requirements, acceptance criteria, and success metrics.
  • Partner with engineering to ensure quality, reliability, and operational readiness.

Lead Through Influence

  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams including product, engineering, data, and IT.
  • Act as the voice of the customer and platform users.
  • Influence architectural and delivery decisions without direct authority.

Enable Platform Governance

  • Drive consistent integration standards and patterns.
  • Reduce technical fragmentation and promote reuse.
  • Ensure security, reliability, and performance expectations are met.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in Product Ownership or Product Management.
  • Strong experience with platform products, integrations, APIs, or distributed systems.
  • Ability to work effectively with engineering and architecture teams.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with enterprise platforms, ERP ecosystems, or large‑scale integrations.
  • Familiarity with cloud‑based integration architectures.
  • Experience in industrial, manufacturing, or dealer‑centric environments.

Why Join Cat Digital

  • Build platforms that power global dealer and enterprise ecosystems.
  • Work at the intersection of product strategy and deep technical platforms.
  • Influence how large‑scale digital integrations are designed and delivered.

Posting Dates

June 15, 2026 - June 28, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community.

title: Product Owner – Global Trade Finance Operations
descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Product Owner – Global Traditional Trade Organization

Department: GTTO / GTFO

About Business line/Function: Global Trade Operations (GTO) is an entity within CIB ITO Global Banking Operations that serves Trade Finance Operations on behalf of the Group. Its scope of intervention is global, on all sites that propose to operate Trade Finance transactions, i.e., in Domestic Core Businesses (FRB, Fortis, BGL, BNL) as in the CIB regions and International Retail Banking (IRB).

Within GTO, the Global Traditional Trade Organization team (GTTO) Act as an overall coordinator to support the global transformation on Traditional Trade Operations for GTO and its partners leveraging on extended team as one team. Thus, GTTO carries out projects around process optimization, Operating Model, and IT Assets for traditional trade products (Letters of Credit, International Guarantees).

Position Purpose: The Product Owner (PO) is the voice of the customer and the business within an Agile development environment. Working closely with cross‑functional teams (Scrum Masters, Developers, Designers, QA, Marketing, Sales, Support, etc.) the PO defines and prioritizes the product backlog, translates market and stakeholder needs into clear, actionable user stories, and ensures that the delivered product maximizes value, aligns with the company’s strategy, and meets quality standards.

Responsibilities

Direct Responsibilities

To deploy a common and business tool with all operational set-ups and provide our clients with Digital Banking capabilities to communicate with the bank.

To develop the product, your mission plan will consist of:

  • Develop Solid knowledge of existing systems and Business Process
  • Build documentation for User requirements / User stories
  • Maintain focus product quality throughout the development, reviewing stories, features and product increments to ensure they meet the user’s needs which are functional and compliant
  • Accountable for delivering the product in line with the business plan.
  • Defining priorities for operation’s needs & support the business requirements by Identifying and formalizing customers’ issues and needs
  • Continuous backlog management, expressing backlog items clearly in a consumable format.
  • Optimize value delivery through continuous improvement, gathering feedback from relevant stakeholders / SME and prioritization of backlog.
  • Ensure voices of the clients and stakeholders are represented.
  • Working with scrum master or project team to build an empowered high performing team
  • Ensure all artifacts and assurance deliverables are as per the required standards and policies.
  • Ensure regular engagement and management of process change, operational and delivery risk for the backlogs is run.
  • Establishing and maintaining reporting to Management.
  • Define and lead governance to ensure that Sponsors/Partners/Contributors are well informed, mobilized and alerted when necessary.
  • Good knowledge of handing JIRA / Agile management tools

Contributing Responsibilities

  • Continuously improving the organization and processes by ensuring that Operational and Compliance risks are controlled,
  • supporting operational teams in organizational changes and the introduction of new processes,

good practice sharing, to transversal projects,

Technical & Behavioral Competencies

Behavioral Skills: (Please select up to four skills)

  • Decision Making
  • Ability to deliver / Results driven.
  • Attention to detail / rigor.
  • Creativity & Innovation / Problem solving.

Transversal Skills: (Please select up to five skills)

  • Analytical Ability
  • Ability to manage a project.
  • Ability to manage / facilitate a meeting, committee, training…
  • Ability to set up relevant performance indicators.

Specific Qualifications

  • Agile & Scrum Knowledge: Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or equivalent; 2+ years of hands‑on PO experience in a Scrum environment.
  • Product Management Fundamentals: Proven history of delivering successful products from concept to market or platform solutions.
  • Analytical Ability Strong quantitative skills
  • Communication & Influence: Excellent written and oral communication; able to influence without authority across multiple business units.
  • Technical Literacy: Basic understanding of software architecture, APIs, and development practices
  • Problem‑Solving Creative thinker: who can break down complex problems into actionable tasks.
  • Stakeholder Management: Experience managing competing priorities and negotiating trade‑offs with senior leadership.

Technical Skills

Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities)

    • Product Owner Knowledge
    • JIRA
    • Agile Scrum
Behavioral Skills

  • Decision Making
  • Ability to deliver / Results driven.
  • Attention to detail / rigor.
  • Creativity & Innovation / Problem solving

Education Level: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent

Location: Chennai /Mumbai

About BNP Paribas Group

BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.

About BNP Paribas India Solutions

Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, colour, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in. title: Associate - Specialist - Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
Specialist - Product Owner - IN

The role act as liaisons between different stakeholders, including engineering, operations, and business to execute product strategy. They maintain and manage the product backlog, or the prioritized list of requirements for future product development.

Key Responsibilities And Duties

  • Incumbents in this role may also be responsible for modernization and integration efforts.
  • Product Owners work very closely with Product Managers to create user stories.
  • They author documents relating to product life cycle including product roadmap, business requirements and functional specifications.
  • They participate in sprint planning, perform market research and competitive analysis leading to the iterative development of the product.

Educational Requirements

  • University (Degree) Preferred

Work Experience

  • 3+ Years Required; 5+ Years Preferred

Physical Requirements

  • Physical Requirements: Sedentary Work

Career Level

7IC

  • Liaising with different stake holders and business users to understand the requirement/problem areas and work with development team to resolve it.
  • Good understanding of Asset management and different asset classes in capital market.
  • Create detailed documentation and flow diagrams for the requirement and proposed solutions
  • Collecting data from various sources via different processes, understand those processes.
  • Exploring and visualizing data.
  • Should be able to write SQL queries and fetch the data and review it.
  • Clearly communicating the findings from the analysis to turn information into something actionable through reports, dashboards, and/or presentations.

Key Skills Required:

  • Analyzing and translating business needs to create and propose solutions through presentations and flow diagram
  • Experience with data integration from multiple sources
  • Experience with End of day and Start of day activities on Accounting book of records
  • Must have Proficiency in at least one query language, especially SQL. (Python Preferred)
  • Must have experience in Asset management domain.
  • Understanding of Performance calculation & Analytics domain
  • Must have experience in different asset classes and their performance, attribution.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL DB is good to have.
  • Good communication skills.

Required Experience- 5-10 Years

Education- Engineering/ Masters (Finance)/CIPM/CFA/FRM or equivalent certification

Related Skills

Continuous Integration and Deployment, Debugging, DevOps, Enterprise Application Integration, Problem Solving, Programming, Software Development, Software Development Life Cycle, Software Testing, Systems Design/Analysis, Systems Development Life Cycle

_____________________________________________________________________________________________________

Company Overview

TIAA Global Capabilities was established in 2016 with a mission to tap into a vast pool of talent, reduce risk by insourcing key platforms and processes, as well as contribute to innovation with a focus on enhancing our technology stack. TIAA Global Capabilities is focused on building a scalable and sustainable organization , with a focus on technology , operations and expanding into the shared services business space.

Working closely with our U.S. colleagues and other partners, our goal is to reduce risk, improve the efficiency of our technology and processes and develop innovative ideas to increase throughput and productivity.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. TIAA does not discriminate against any candidate or employee on the basis of age, race, color, national origin, sex, religion, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other legally protected status.

Our Culture of Impact

At TIAA, we're on a mission to build on our 100+ year legacy of delivering for our clients while evolving to meet tomorrow's challenges. We equip our associates with future-focused skills and AI tools that enable us to advance our mission. Together, we are fighting to ensure a more secure financial future for all and for generations to come. We are guided by our values: Champion Our People, Be Client Obsessed, Lead with Integrity, Own It, and Win As One. They influence every decision we make and how we work together to serve our clients every day. We thrive in a collaborative in-office environment where teams work across organizational boundaries with shared purpose, accelerating innovation and delivering meaningful results. Our workplace brings together TIAA and Nuveen's entrepreneurial spirit, where we work hard and work together to create lasting impact. Here, every associate can grow through meaningful learning experiences and development pathways—because when our people succeed, our impact on clients' lives grows stronger.

Accessibility Support

TIAA offers support for those who need assistance with our online application process to provide an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals with disabilities.

If you are a U.S. applicant and desire a reasonable accommodation to complete a job application please use one of the below options to contact our accessibility support team:

title: Senior Staff Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

Job Summary

The Senior Staff Product Owner (PO) is a member of the R&D development team responsible for bridging the gap between market requirements, as defined by Product Management, and the technical solution. This role owns the developed solution throughout the entire development lifecycle, from planning and development to a successful customer release. The PO works closely with the Development Team, Product Management, Professional Services, Technical Writers, and R&D management.

Key Responsibilities

  • Produce valuable content for our customers.
  • Own the product backlog by deconstructing large features into smaller pieces, then defining and prioritizing them to compose a releasable product.
  • Act as the central focal point for all internal and external parties on how the product works, its capabilities, and the effects of any changes.
  • Analyze product business requirements and produce a functional design.
  • Utilize deep knowledge of the product and its customer use cases to collaborate with R&D, explain requirements, and answer functional questions.
  • Lead large, high-visibility projects that involve multiple development teams.

Qualifications

  • 5-8 years of experience as a functional analyst, product owner, business analyst, or in product management within the software industry.
  • BTech, or BE in Computer Science/Engineering, or 3-5 years of hands-on experience in software development.
  • Deep expertise in Digital Identity and Access Management (IAM), including protocols (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML 2.0), MFA, SCIM, SSO, federation, and access control models (RBAC/ABAC/PBAC/ReBAC).
  • Proven technical skills and self-learning ability, capable of thoroughly understanding the functional and technical aspects of IAM domains.
  • Experience in writing functional designs.
  • Proven Agile experience.
  • Proven management skills.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Proactive, highly motivated individual with a serious work ethic and goal-oriented approach.
  • Innovative 'out of the box' thinker.
  • Experience with an AI-First strategy for initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in a pre-sale or post-sale role.
  • Information security experience.

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.
